title.zh: 卷三 魏本紀第三: 高祖孝文帝
title.en: Volume 3 Wei Annals 3: Emperor Gaozu Xiaowen
title.raw: 卷三 魏本紀第三: 高祖孝文帝 Volume 3 Wei Annals 3: Emperor Gaozu Xiaowen

sentences.zh: 高祖孝文帝

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu Xiaowen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu Xiaowen.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔求舜後，獲東萊人媯茍之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, an edict sought descendants of Shun; a man of Donglai named Gui Gouzhi was found.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the court issued an edict to find Shun's line; they discovered Gui Gouzhi of Donglai.

sentences.zh: 復其家畢世，以彰盛德之不朽。

translations.literal: His household was restored for all generations, to manifest the imperishable greatness of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: His family was reinstated in perpetuity, proclaiming that supreme virtue endures.

sentences.zh: 復前濮陽王孔雀本封。

translations.literal: The former enfeoffment of Prince of Puyang Kong Que was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Puyang Kong Que received back his original fief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，徙趙郡王穆亮為長樂王。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Prince of Zhao Commandery Mu Liang was transferred to be Prince of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince of Zhao Commandery Mu Liang was made Prince of Changle.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，大陽蠻酋桓誕率戶內屬，拜征南將軍，封襄陽王。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, in the first month, the great Yang barbarian chieftain Huan Dan led his households to submit; he was appointed General Who Conquers the South and enfeoffed as Prince of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, first month, the great Yang chieftain Huan Dan brought his people inward; he was named General Who Conquers the South and enfeoffed Prince of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 曲赦京師及河西，南至秦、涇，西至枹罕，北至涼州及諸鎮。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted for the capital and Hexi, south to Qin and Jing, west to Fuhan, north to Liang Province and the garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: The court pardoned the capital and Hexi, from Qin and Jing in the south to Fuhan in the west and Liang Province and the frontier posts in the north.

sentences.zh: 詔假員外散騎常侍邢佑使於宋。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Xing You envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Xing You to go on embassy to Song.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，詔曰：「頃者，淮徐未賓，尼父廟隔非所，致令祠典寢頓，禮章殄滅，遂使女巫妖覡淫進非禮。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingsi, an edict said: "Recently Huai and Xu have not yet submitted; the temple of the Master lies beyond our borders, causing the sacrificial rites to lapse and ceremonial regulations to perish, so that shamanesses and sorcerers have intruded with improper rites."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingsi day, an edict declared: "Because Huai and Xu are not yet loyal, Confucius's temple lies outside our reach; rites have fallen idle and ceremony has died away, and shamans and witches now press in with forbidden practices."

sentences.zh: 自今有祭孔廟，制用酒脯而已，不聽婦女雜合，以祈非望之福。

translations.literal: From now on, when sacrificing at the Confucian temple, only wine and dried meat are to be used; no women are to mingle in the rites to seek blessings beyond what is proper.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth temple offerings to Confucius shall be wine and meat alone; women must not join the rites to beg unseemly favors.

sentences.zh: 犯者以違制論。

translations.literal: Offenders are to be punished for violation of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever breaks this rule shall be punished as a violator of statute.

sentences.zh: 其公家有事，自如常禮。

translations.literal: When the government has business, the usual rites apply as before.
translations.idiomatic: For state occasions the ordinary ceremonies still hold.

sentences.zh: 」蠕蠕犯塞，太上皇帝次於北郊，詔諸將討之，悉皆遁走。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided the frontier; the Retired Emperor halted at the northern suburb and ordered the generals to attack; they all fled away.
translations.idiomatic: Rouran raiders struck the border; the Retired Emperor camped at the northern suburb and sent generals against them, and the enemy fled.

sentences.zh: 北部敕勒叛，奔蠕蠕。

translations.literal: The Tiele of the northern region rebelled and fled to the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Tiele tribes rebelled and escaped to the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 太上皇帝追至石磧，不及而還。

translations.literal: The Retired Emperor pursued them to Shiji but did not overtake them and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Retired Emperor chased them to Shiji, failed to catch them, and turned back.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，以散騎常侍、駙馬都尉萬安國為大司馬、大將軍，封安城王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuchen, Wan Anguo, Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry and Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law, was made Grand Marshal and Grand General and enfeoffed as Prince of Ancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the third month Wan Anguo, Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry and Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-Law, became Grand Marshal and Grand General, Prince of Ancheng.

sentences.zh: 庚午，親耕籍田。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the emperor plowed the sacred field himself.

sentences.zh: 連川敕勒謀叛，徙配青、徐、齊、兗四州為營戶。

translations.literal: The Tiele of Lianchuan plotted rebellion; they were relocated and assigned as camp households in the four provinces of Qing, Xu, Qi, and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Lianchuan Tiele plotted revolt and were moved to Qing, Xu, Qi, and Yan as camp households.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，詔工商雜伎，盡聽赴農。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengzi, an edict ordered that artisans, merchants, and miscellaneous performers all be allowed to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the fourth month of summer an edict sent artisans, traders, and entertainers back to the fields.

sentences.zh: 諸州課人益種菜果。

translations.literal: The provinces were ordered to have the people plant more vegetables and fruit as tax produce.
translations.idiomatic: Each province was told to levy extra planting of vegetables and fruit.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, men from Song came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day envoys arrived from Song.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔沙門不得去寺，行者以公文。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, an edict forbade Buddhist monks to leave their monasteries; travelers must carry official documents.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day monks were forbidden to leave their temples; anyone traveling had to carry government papers.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋明帝殂。

translations.literal: That month, Emperor Ming of Song died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Song's Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，詔軍警給璽印傳符，次給馬印。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingsi, an edict ordered that in military emergencies the imperial seal and transmission tallies be issued first, and horse seals second.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fifth month an edict said that in military crisis the imperial seal and passes come first, horse seals second.

sentences.zh: 六月，安州遭水雹，詔丐租振恤。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, An Province suffered flood and hail; an edict remitted rents and granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month flood and hail struck An Province; rents were forgiven and relief granted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔：「今年貢舉，尤為猥濫。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, an edict said: "This year's tribute recommendations have been especially coarse and excessive."
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict read: "This year's recommended candidates are shamefully numerous and unworthy."

sentences.zh: 自今所遣，皆可門盡州郡之高，才極鄉閭之選。

translations.literal: "Henceforth those sent forth must be the highest in talent their prefecture and commandery can offer, the utmost choice of village and hamlet."
translations.idiomatic: "From now on each nominee must be the finest talent the district can show and the best the countryside can yield."

sentences.zh: 」戊午，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the emperor traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court moved to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，詔州郡縣各遣二人才堪專對者，赴九月講武，當親問風俗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renyin, an edict ordered each province, commandery, and county to send two men of talent fit for specialized discourse, to attend the autumn military review in the ninth month, when the emperor would personally inquire into local customs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the seventh month of autumn each province, commandery, and county was told to send two men able to debate on command for the ninth-month review, when the emperor would ask them about local ways.

sentences.zh: 八月，百濟遣使請兵伐高麗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Baekje sent envoys requesting troops to attack Goguryeo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Baekje asked for soldiers to strike Goguryeo.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinsi, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the ninth month the emperor came back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，統萬鎮將、河間王閭武皮坐貪殘賜死。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the garrison commander of Tongwan, Prince of Hejian Lü Wupi, was sentenced to death for greed and cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Lü Wupi, Prince of Hejian and commander at Tongwan, was executed for rapacity and brutality.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔以州鎮十一水旱，丐其田租，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, an edict ordered that in eleven provinces and garrisons suffering flood or drought, field rents be remitted and granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day eleven provinces and posts hit by flood or drought had rents forgiven and storehouses opened.

sentences.zh: 又詔流迸之人，皆令還本，違者徙邊。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered that persons who had fled and drifted away must all return to their native places; violators were to be relocated to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict commanded wanderers home; those who refused were sent to the border.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，蠕蠕犯塞，及五原。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Rouran raided the frontier as far as Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Rouran raiders reached the frontier and Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，太上皇帝親討之，將度漠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Retired Emperor personally campaigned against them and was about to cross the desert.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Retired Emperor led a campaign in person and prepared to cross the desert.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕聞之，北走數千里。

translations.literal: When the Rouran heard of it, they fled north for several thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, the Rouran fled north thousands of li.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，封皇叔略為廣川王。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the emperor's uncle Lüe was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the emperor's uncle Lüe was made Prince of Guangchuan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，分遣使者巡省風俗，問人疾苦。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, envoys were dispatched separately to tour and inspect local customs and inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day separate envoys were sent to tour the realm, study custom, and ask after suffering.

sentences.zh: 帝每月一朝崇光宮。

translations.literal: Each month the emperor paid court once at Chongguang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Every month the emperor attended court at Chongguang Palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，詔曰：「頃者以來，官以勞升，未久而代。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengxu, an edict said: "In recent times officials have been promoted for merit and replaced before long."
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the twelfth month an edict said: "Lately men rise for service and are replaced almost at once."

sentences.zh: 牧守無恤人之心，競為聚斂，送故迎新，相屬於路，非所以固人志、隆政道也。

translations.literal: Prefects and governors lack care for the people's hearts and vie to amass wealth; seeing off the old and welcoming the new crowd the roads, which is not the way to fix men's wills and elevate government."
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates and governors show no mercy and race to enrich themselves; farewell processions and welcome parades choke the highways, which cannot steady hearts or dignify rule."

sentences.zh: 自今牧守溫良仁儉、克己奉公者，可久於其任。

translations.literal: From now on, those who are mild, benevolent, frugal, and self-restraining in service of the public may hold office for a long term.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth mild, kind, frugal men who keep the public good may stay long in post.

sentences.zh: 歲積有成，遷位一級；

translations.literal: When year upon year they achieve results, they are promoted one rank;
translations.idiomatic: After years of good work they advance one step in rank;

sentences.zh: 其貪殘非道，侵削黎庶者，雖在官甫爾，必加黜罰。

translations.literal: those who are greedy, cruel, and lawless and who oppress the common people, even if they have just taken office, will surely be punished and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: but the greedy, cruel, and lawless who harm the people, though newly appointed, will be punished and removed at once.

sentences.zh: 著之於令，以為彜準。

translations.literal: This is to be written into the statutes as the constant standard.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be entered in the code as the lasting rule.

sentences.zh: 」詔以代郡事同豐沛，代人先配邊戍者免之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that because Dai Commandery was comparable to Feng and Pei, those of Dai ancestry previously assigned to frontier garrison duty were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said Dai Commandery ranked with Feng and Pei, and men of Dai stock once posted to frontier garrison were freed from that duty.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、地豆于、庫莫奚、高昌等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, Didouyu, Kumo Xi, Gaochang, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Didouyu, Kumo Xi, Gaochang, and others sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月庚辰，詔員外散騎常侍崔演使於宋。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the day gengchen in the first month, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Cui Yan envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year three, on gengchen of the first month, Acting Staff Officer Cui Yan was sent to Song.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，改崇光宮為寧光宮。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Chongguang Palace was renamed Ningguang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Chongguang Palace became Ningguang Palace.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，太上皇帝至自北討，飲至策勛，告於宗廟。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuwu, the Retired Emperor returned from the northern campaign; a victory feast was held and merit recorded, and report was made at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the second month the Retired Emperor came back from the northern expedition; the court held a triumph feast, recorded merit, and reported to the ancestors.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔縣令能靜一縣劫盜者，兼理二縣，即食其祿；

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, an edict said that if a county magistrate could pacify banditry in one county, he might concurrently govern two counties and receive both salaries;
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict promised that a magistrate who could quiet one county's bandits might govern two and draw both salaries;

sentences.zh: 能靜三縣者，三年遷為郡守。

translations.literal: if he could pacify three counties, after three years he would be promoted to commandery governor.
translations.idiomatic: if he could quiet three, after three years he would become commandery governor.

sentences.zh: 二千石能靜二郡上至三郡，亦如之，三年遷為刺史。

translations.literal: If a two-thousand-dan official could pacify two commanderies up to three commanderies, the same rule applied; after three years he would be promoted to regional inspector.
translations.idiomatic: A two-thousand-bushel official who could quiet two or three commanderies would likewise rise to regional inspector after three years.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，詔諸倉屯穀麥充積者，出賜貧人。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renwu, an edict ordered that grain and wheat stored in the granaries and depots be issued to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the third month grain hoarded in state granaries was given to the poor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，詔假司空、上黨王長孫觀等討吐谷渾拾寅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wushen, an edict appointed Acting Minister of Works, Prince of Shangdang Changsun Guan, and others to campaign against Tuyuhun She'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the fourth month of summer Acting Minister of Works Prince of Shangdang Changsun Guan and others were sent against Tuyuhun She'an.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔以孔子二十八世孫魯郡孔乘為崇聖大夫，給十戶以供灑掃。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict appointed Kong Sheng of Lu Commandery, twenty-eighth-generation descendant of Confucius, as Grand Master of Sacred Sagacity, with ten households granted for temple upkeep.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Kong Sheng of Lu, Confucius's twenty-eighth-generation heir, was named Grand Master of Sacred Sagacity with ten households for sweeping the temple.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，詔曰：「往年縣召秀才二人，問守宰善惡，而賞者未幾，罪者眾多，肆法傷生，情所未忍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiazi, an edict said: "In former years each county summoned two xiucai to be questioned on the goodness or wickedness of prefects and magistrates, yet those rewarded were few while those punished were many; wanton use of the law harmed lives, which our hearts could not bear."
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the sixth month an edict recalled: "We once called two xiucai per county to judge their magistrates; few were praised and many punished, and law ran wild at the cost of lives, which we could not endure."

sentences.zh: 諸為人所列者，特原其罪，盡可代之。

translations.literal: All who had been denounced by others were specially pardoned of their crimes and might all be replaced by substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone impeached by another was pardoned outright and might send a substitute in his place.

sentences.zh: 」秋七月，詔河南六州人，戶收絹一匹、綿一斤、租三十石。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, an edict ordered the people of the six provinces south of the Yellow River to pay one bolt of silk and one jin of cotton per household, and thirty shi of rent grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn the six provinces south of the river were told to pay one bolt of silk, one jin of cotton, and thirty shi of rent per household.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the emperor traveled to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the court went to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，帝從太上皇帝幸河西。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengshen, the emperor followed the Retired Emperor to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the eighth month the emperor accompanied the Retired Emperor to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 拾寅謝罪請降，許之。

translations.literal: She'an apologized and asked to surrender; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: She'an begged pardon and offered surrender; the court accepted.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinsi, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the ninth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, men from Song came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Song envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔曰：「今京師及天下囚未判，在獄致死，無近親者，給衣衾棺櫝葬之，不得暴露。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, an edict said: "Prisoners in the capital and throughout the realm who have not yet been sentenced and die in jail without close kin shall be given clothing, quilts, coffins, and burial; they must not be left exposed."
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict said: "Unsentenced prisoners who die in jail in the capital or the provinces without kin shall receive shrouds and coffins and be buried, not left exposed."

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，詔遣十使，循行州郡，撿括戶口。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict dispatched ten envoys to tour the provinces and commanderies and check household registers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day ten envoys were sent to tour the provinces and audit household registers.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，太上皇帝將南討，詔州郡之人，十丁取一，充行；

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Retired Emperor was about to campaign south; an edict ordered that of the people in the provinces and commanderies, one man in ten be taken for service;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, as the Retired Emperor prepared a southern campaign, one man in ten was levied from the provinces;

sentences.zh: 戶租五十石，以備軍糧。

translations.literal: each household was to pay fifty shi of rent grain to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: each household paid fifty shi of rent grain for the army.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，詔以河南州郡牧守多不奉法，致新邦百姓莫能上達。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuyin, an edict said that prefects and governors of the provinces south of the Yellow River mostly did not uphold the law, so that the people of the newly acquired territories could not reach the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the eleventh month an edict said that governors south of the river often broke the law, so new subjects could not reach the throne.

sentences.zh: 遣使者觀風察獄，黜陟幽明，搜揚振恤。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to observe local customs and examine lawsuits, to demote the obscure and promote the clear, and to search out and relieve suffering.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to study custom, review cases, dismiss the wicked and raise the worthy, and bring relief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太上皇帝南巡至懷州，所過問人疾苦，賜高年孝悌力田布帛。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Retired Emperor toured south to Huai Province; wherever he passed he inquired into the people's hardships and bestowed cloth and silk on the elderly, the filial, the brotherly, and those who worked the fields with strength.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Retired Emperor went south to Huai Province, asked after hardship along the route, and gave cloth to the aged, the filial, the brotherly, and the industrious.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the first of the twelfth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔關外苑囿，聽人樵采。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, an edict permitted people to gather firewood in the imperial parks beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day people were allowed to cut firewood in the royal parks outside the passes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、契丹、庫莫奚、悉萬斤等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Xiwenjin, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Xiwenjin, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 州鎮十一水旱，丐人田租，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: Eleven provinces and garrisons suffered flood or drought; field rents were remitted and granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven provinces and posts suffered flood or drought; rents were forgiven and granaries opened.

sentences.zh: 相州人餓死者二千八百四十五人。

translations.literal: In Xiang Province, 2,845 people died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiang Province 2,845 people starved to death.

sentences.zh: 妖人劉舉自稱天子，齊州刺史、武昌王平原捕斬之。

translations.literal: The sorcerer Liu Ju proclaimed himself Son of Heaven; the regional inspector of Qi Province, Prince of Wuchang Pingyuan, captured and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: The wizard Liu Ju called himself Son of Heaven; Prince of Wuchang Pingyuan, regional inspector of Qi, seized and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the first day guiyou of the first month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the first day of spring in year four, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太尉、隴西王源賀以病辭位。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Grand Commandant Yuan He of Longxi requested leave from office on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Grand Commandant Yuan He of Longxi resigned for illness.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，太上皇帝至自南巡。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiachen, the Retired Emperor returned from the southern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the second month the Retired Emperor came back from the southern tour.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁寒食。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the Cold Food Festival was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Cold Food Festival was banned.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，詔員外散騎常侍許赤武使於宋。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dinghai, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Xu Chiwu envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the third month Acting Staff Officer Xu Chiwu was sent to Song.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯詔：自今非謀反大逆，干紀外奔，罪止其身而已。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day dingmao, an edict said: From now on, except for treason, great rebellion, violation of fundamental norms, or flight abroad, guilt stops with the person himself alone.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fourth month of summer an edict ruled: except for treason, great rebellion, breach of cardinal law, or flight abroad, punishment ends with the offender alone.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，曲赦仇池。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jimao, a partial amnesty was granted for Chouchi.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the seventh month of autumn Chouchi received a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，大閱於北郊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wushen, a grand review was held at the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eighth month the army was reviewed at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 九月，以宋亂故，詔將軍元蘭等伐蜀漢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, because of disorder in Song, an edict ordered Generals Yuan Lan and others to attack Shu-Han.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, with Song in turmoil, Generals Yuan Lan and others were sent against Shu-Han.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day gengzi, men from Song came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the tenth month of winter Song envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 十一月，分遣侍臣循河南七州，觀察風俗，撫慰初附。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, attendant ministers were dispatched separately to tour the seven provinces south of the Yellow River, observe local customs, and comfort those newly submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month attendant ministers toured the seven provinces south of the river, studied custom, and comforted the newly loyal.

sentences.zh: 是歲，粟特、敕勒、吐谷渾、高麗、曹利、闊悉、契丹、庫莫奚、地豆于等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Sogdiana, Tiele, Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, Cao Li, Kuo Xi, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Didouyu, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sogdiana, Tiele, Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, Cao Li, Kuo Xi, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Didouyu, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 州鎮十三大饑，丐人田租，開倉振之。

translations.literal: Thirteen provinces and garrisons suffered great famine; field rents were remitted and granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen provinces and posts suffered great famine; rents were forgiven and granaries opened.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，詔群公卿士，有便人益國者，具狀以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiazi, an edict ordered dukes, ministers, and scholar-officials who had measures beneficial to the people and the state to set them forth in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month dukes, ministers, and scholars with plans to benefit people and state were told to submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以長安二蠶多死，丐人歲賦之半。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, because both silkworm crops in Chang'an had largely died, half the year's levy was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, with both silkworm crops largely dead in Chang'an, half the annual levy was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dinghai, a partial amnesty was granted for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the ninth month the capital received a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，起七寶永安行殿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingsi, the Seven-Jewel Yong'an traveling palace was begun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the tenth month of winter work began on the Seven-Jewel Yong'an traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，進假東陽王丕爵為王。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Acting Prince of Dongyang Pi was advanced in noble rank to full prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Acting Prince of Dongyang Pi was raised to full princely rank.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔群官卿士下及吏人，各聽上書，直言極諫，勿有所隱。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, an edict permitted all officials, from ministers down to clerks and commoners, to submit memorials in their own hand, speaking frankly and remonstrating to the utmost, with nothing concealed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day ministers, officials, clerks, and commoners alike were invited to submit written remonstrance without concealment.

sentences.zh: 諸有益政利人可以正風俗者，有司以聞。

translations.literal: Whatever might benefit government, profit the people, or rectify custom, the relevant offices were to report.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever would aid rule, help the people, or set custom right was to be reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸建明佛寺，大宥罪人。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the emperor visited Jianming Buddhist Temple and granted a great pardon to criminals.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the emperor visited Jianming Temple and pardoned criminals in grand amnesty.

sentences.zh: 進濟南公羅拔為王。

translations.literal: Prince of Ji'nan Luo Ba was advanced to princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ji'nan Luo Ba was raised to full prince.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、庫莫奚、波斯、契丹、宕昌、悉萬斤等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Rouran, Goguryeo, Kumo Xi, Persia, Khitan, Dangchang, Xiwenjin, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Goguryeo, Kumo Xi, Persia, Khitan, Dangchang, Xiwenjin, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，樂安王良薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Prince of Le'an Liang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Prince of Le'an Liang died.

sentences.zh: 詔復前東郡王陸定國官爵。

translations.literal: An edict restored the office and noble rank of the former Prince of Dongjun Lu Dingguo.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored former Prince of Dongjun Lu Dingguo to office and rank.

sentences.zh: 五月，車駕祈雨於武州山，俄而澍雨大洽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the imperial carriage prayed for rain at Wuzhou Mountain; soon a great soaking rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the emperor prayed for rain at Wuzhou Mountain, and a soaking rain followed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，京兆王子推薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renchen, Prince of Jingzhao Zi Tui died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the seventh month of autumn Prince of Jingzhao Zi Tui died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，定三等死刑。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, three grades of capital punishment were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day three grades of capital punishment were fixed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，起朱明、思賢門。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the Zhuming and Sixian gates were begun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day work began on the Zhuming and Sixian gates.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋人殺其主昱。

translations.literal: That month, the men of Song killed their ruler Yu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the men of Song killed their ruler Yu.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the eighth month a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔曰：「工商皂隸，各有厥分，而有司縱濫，或染清流。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an edict said: "Artisans, merchants, and bond servants each have their station, yet officials have indulged them and some have stained the clear current."
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict said: "Artisans, traders, and bondsmen have their stations, yet officials have let some pollute the pure stream."

sentences.zh: 自今戶內有工役者，唯止本部丞，已下準次而授。

translations.literal: From now on, households with craftsmen in service shall receive only the assistant of their own bureau, and ranks below shall be granted in order.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth households with craftsmen in service receive only their bureau's assistant; lower ranks follow in sequence.

sentences.zh: 若階藉元勛以勞定國者，不從此制。

translations.literal: Those whose pedigree records founding merit and who have settled the state through labor are not bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: Men of founding merit who settled the state by labor are exempt from this rule.

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, men from Song came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day envoys came from Song.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，詔群臣定律令於太華殿。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yiyou, an edict ordered the ministers to codify laws and statutes in Taihua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the ninth month ministers were ordered to draft laws in Taihua Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，起永樂遊觀殿於北苑，穿神泉池。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Yongle touring palace was begun in the northern park, and the Divine Spring Pool was dug.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Yongle touring palace was begun in the northern park and the Divine Spring Pool dug.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day xinhai, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the first of the tenth month of winter, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宴京邑耆老年七十已上於太華殿，賜以衣服。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, elders of the capital aged seventy and above were feasted in Taihua Hall and given clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day elders of the capital aged seventy and above were feasted in Taihua Hall and given clothes.

sentences.zh: 詔七十已上一子不從役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for those seventy and above, one son per household was exempt from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted one son per household for men aged seventy and above.

sentences.zh: 宋葭蘆戍主楊文度遣弟鼠襲陷仇池。

translations.literal: Yang Wendu, commander of the Jialu garrison of Song, sent his younger brother Shu to raid and seize Chouchi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Wendu, Song commander at Jialu, sent his brother Shu to raid and seize Chouchi.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，懷州人伊祁茍自稱堯後，應王，聚眾於重山。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dinghai, a man of Huai Province named Yi Qi Gou proclaimed himself a descendant of Yao and responded to a pretender, gathering a crowd at Chong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the eleventh month Yi Qi Gou of Huai Province called himself Yao's heir, answered a pretender, and gathered men at Chong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 洛州刺史馮熙討平之。

translations.literal: Regional Inspector of Luo Province Feng Xi campaigned and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Xi, regional inspector of Luo, suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚午，詔員外散騎常侍李長仁使於宋。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day gengwu, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Li Changren envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the intercalary month Acting Staff Officer Li Changren was sent to Song.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，征西將軍皮喜攻陷葭蘆，斬楊文度，傳首京師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renyin, General Who Conquers the West Pi Xi attacked and took Jialu, beheaded Yang Wendu, and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the twelfth month General Who Conquers the West Pi Xi took Jialu, beheaded Yang Wendu, and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，州郡八水旱蝗，人饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, eight provinces and commanderies suffered flood, drought, or locusts and the people were hungry; an edict opened granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day eight provinces and commanderies suffered flood, drought, or locusts; granaries were opened.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、契丹、庫莫奚、蠕蠕、車多羅、西天竺、舍衛、疊伏羅、栗楊婆、員闊等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Rouran, Cheduoluo, western Tianzhu, Shewei, Diefuluo, Liyangpo, Yuan Kuo, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Rouran, Cheduoluo, western Tianzhu, Shewei, Diefuluo, Liyangpo, Yuan Kuo, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁巳，封昌黎王馮熙第二子始興為北平王。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, on the day dingsi in the first month, the second son of Prince of Changli Feng Xi, Shixing, was enfeoffed as Prince of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, on dingsi of the first month, Feng Xi's second son Shixing was enfeoffed Prince of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，行幸代之湯泉，所過問人疾苦，以宮女賜貧人無妻者。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dinghai, the emperor traveled to the hot springs of Dai; wherever he passed he inquired into the people's hardships and gave palace women to poor men without wives.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the second month the emperor went to Dai's hot springs, asked after hardship, and gave palace women to poor men without wives.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, yiyou, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸丑，坤德六合殿成。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the day guichou in the first month, the Kunde Six Harmonies Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the first month of year three the Kunde Six Harmonies Hall was finished.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔罷行察官。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an edict abolished touring inspection officials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day touring inspection officials were abolished.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，帝、太皇太后幸代郡湯泉，問人疾苦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinsi, the Emperor and the Grand Empress Dowager visited the hot springs of Dai Commandery and inquired into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the second month the Emperor and Grand Empress Dowager visited Dai's hot springs and asked after suffering.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡貧者妻以宮女。

translations.literal: Widowers and the poor were given palace women as wives.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers and the poor received palace women as wives.

sentences.zh: 己亥，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, they returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day they returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day guimao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the first of the third month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, a partial amnesty was granted for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the capital received a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day renshen, men from Song came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the fourth month of summer Song envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 癸未，樂良王樂平薨。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Prince of Leliang Yueping died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Prince of Leliang Yueping died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，宋順帝禪位於齊。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Emperor Shun of Song abdicated in favor of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Emperor Shun of Song abdicated to Qi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，進淮陽公尉元爵為王。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Duke of Huaiyang Wei Yuan was advanced in noble rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Duke of Huaiyang Wei Yuan was raised to prince.

sentences.zh: 宜都王目辰有罪賜死。

translations.literal: Prince of Yidu Mu Chen, guilty of crime, was sentenced to death by gift.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Yidu Mu Chen, guilty of crime, was granted death.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，帝祈雨於北苑，閉陽門，是日澍雨大洽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day dingsi, the Emperor prayed for rain in the northern park and closed the Yang Gate; that day a great soaking rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fifth month the Emperor prayed for rain in the northern park and closed the Yang Gate; a soaking rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，以雍州人饑，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinwei, because the people of Yong Province were hungry, granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the sixth month Yong Province was hungry and granaries were opened.

sentences.zh: 起文石室靈泉殿於方山。

translations.literal: The Wenshi Chamber and Lingquan Hall were built on Fang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Wenshi Chamber and Lingquan Hall were raised on Fang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，詔免宮人年老及病者。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renyin, an edict released palace women who were aged or ill.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the seventh month of autumn aged and ill palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，詔群臣進直言。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renshen, an edict ordered the ministers to submit forthright remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the eighth month ministers were told to submit frank remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸方山，起思遠佛寺。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, he visited Fang Mountain and built the Siyuan Buddhist Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he visited Fang Mountain and built Siyuan Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，以司徒、東陽王丕為太尉；

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renzi, Minister of Works Prince of Dongyang Pi was made Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the ninth month Minister of Works Prince of Dongyang Pi became Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 趙郡公陳建為司徒，進爵魏郡王；

translations.literal: Duke of Zhao Commandery Chen Jian was made Minister of Works and advanced in noble rank to Prince of Wei Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Zhao Commandery Chen Jian became Minister of Works and was raised Prince of Wei Commandery;

sentences.zh: 河南公茍頹為司空，進爵河東王。

translations.literal: Duke of Henan Gou Tui was made Minister of Works and advanced in noble rank to Prince of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Henan Gou Tui became Minister of Works and was raised Prince of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 進太原公王睿中山王，隴東公張佑新平王。

translations.literal: Duke of Taiyuan Wang Rui was advanced to Prince of Zhongshan, and Duke of Longdong Zhang You to Prince of Xinping.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Taiyuan Wang Rui became Prince of Zhongshan and Duke of Longdong Zhang You Prince of Xinping.

sentences.zh: 乙未，定州刺史、安樂王長樂有罪賜死。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Prince of Anle Chang Le, regional inspector of Ding Province, guilty of crime, was sentenced to death by gift.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Prince of Anle Chang Le, regional inspector of Ding, guilty of crime, was granted death.

sentences.zh: 庚申，隴西王源賀薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Yuan He of Longxi died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Yuan He of Longxi died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳朔，大赦。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day jisi, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the first of the tenth month of winter, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，賜京師貧窮高年疾患不能自存衣服布帛各有差。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guimao, the poor, elderly, and sick of the capital who could not support themselves were given clothing and cloth in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the eleventh month the capital's poor, aged, and sick who could not support themselves received cloth and clothes in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，進假梁郡公元嘉爵為假王，督二將出淮陰；

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Acting Prince of Liang Commandery Yuan Jia was advanced in noble rank to acting prince and ordered to command two generals out from Huaiyin;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Acting Prince of Liang Commandery Yuan Jia was raised to acting prince and ordered to lead two generals from Huaiyin;

sentences.zh: 隴西公元琛三將出廣陵；

translations.literal: Prince of Longxi Yuan Chen with three generals out from Guangling;
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Longxi Yuan Chen with three generals from Guangling;

sentences.zh: 河東公薛豹子三將出廣固，至壽春。

translations.literal: Duke of Hedong Xue Baozi with three generals out from Guanggu, reaching Shouchun.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Hedong Xue Baozi with three generals from Guanggu as far as Shouchun.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、高麗、蠕蠕、地豆于、契丹、庫莫奚、龜茲、粟特、州逸、河龔、疊伏羅、員闊、悉萬斤等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, Rouran, Didouyu, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Kucha, Sogdiana, Zhou Yi, He Gong, Diefuluo, Yuan Kuo, Xiwenjin, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, Rouran, Didouyu, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Kucha, Sogdiana, Zhou Yi, He Gong, Diefuluo, Yuan Kuo, Xiwenjin, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸卯，乾象六合殿成。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the day guimao in the first month, the Qianxiang Six Harmonies Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the first month of year four the Qianxiang Six Harmonies Hall was finished.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，廣川王略薨。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Prince of Guangchuan Lüe died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Prince of Guangchuan Lüe died.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，罷畜鷹鷂之所，以其地為報德佛寺。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the grounds for keeping hawks and falcons were abolished and the land made into the Baode Buddhist Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day the hawk and falcon yards were abolished and the land became Baode Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊午，襄城王韓頹有罪，削爵徙邊。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Prince of Xiangcheng Han Tui, guilty of crime, was stripped of rank and relocated to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince of Xiangcheng Han Tui, guilty of crime, was stripped of rank and sent to the border.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，以旱故，詔天下祀山川群神及能興雲雨者，修飾祠堂，薦以牲璧。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guisi, because of drought an edict ordered the realm to sacrifice to mountains, rivers, spirits, and all who can raise clouds and rain; shrines were to be repaired and offerings of victims and jade made.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the second month, for drought, the realm was told to sacrifice to mountains, rivers, spirits, and rain-makers; shrines were repaired and victims and jade offered.

sentences.zh: 人有疾苦，所在存問。

translations.literal: Wherever people suffered hardship, local officials were to inquire and care for them.
translations.idiomatic: Where people suffered, local officials were to inquire and care for them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，幸廷尉、籍坊二獄，引見諸囚。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yimao, the emperor visited the prisons of the Minister of Justice and the registry workshop and summoned the prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the fourth month of summer the emperor visited the Minister of Justice's prison and the registry workshop and saw the prisoners.

sentences.zh: 詔隨輕重決遣，以赴耕耘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered release according to the gravity of offense, so they could return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered release by gravity of offense so they could return to the fields.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賜天下貧人一戶之內無雜財谷帛者廩一年。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, households throughout the realm without miscellaneous property, grain, cloth, or silk were granted one year's grain from the state granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day poor households without property or grain received one year's grain from state granaries.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，以澍雨大洽，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, because a great soaking rain had fallen, a partial amnesty was granted for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the sixth month, after a soaking rain, the capital received a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，行幸火山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinhai, the emperor traveled to Huoshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the seventh month of autumn the emperor went to Huoshan.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔會京師耆老，賜錦彩衣服几杖稻米蜜面，復家人不徭役。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict assembled the elders of the capital and bestowed brocade, colored cloth, clothing, staffs, rice, honey, and flour; their households were exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the elders of the capital were assembled and given brocade, cloth, clothes, staffs, rice, honey, and flour; their households were freed from corvée.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁亥，幸獸圈，親錄囚徒，輕者皆免之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day dinghai, the emperor visited the animal park and personally recorded the prisoners; the lighter cases were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the intercalary month the emperor visited the animal park, reviewed prisoners, and pardoned the lighter cases.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，頓丘王李鐘葵有罪賜死。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Prince of Dunqiu Li Zhongkui, guilty of crime, was sentenced to death by gift.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Dunqiu Li Zhongkui, guilty of crime, was granted death.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，詔諸州置冰室。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiyou, an edict ordered all provinces to establish ice houses.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the eighth month all provinces were ordered to establish ice houses.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，思義殿成。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yihai, the Siyi Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the ninth month the Siyi Hall was finished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，東明觀成。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Dongming Observatory was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Dongming Observatory was finished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔曰：「隆寒雪降，可遣侍臣詣廷尉獄及囚所，察饑寒者給以衣食，桎梏者代以輕鎖。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, an edict said: "With deep cold and snow falling, attendant ministers may be sent to the prisons of the Minister of Justice and to places of detention to examine those suffering hunger or cold and give them food and clothing; those in cangues and fetters shall have lighter bonds substituted."
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict said: "In deep cold and snow, send ministers to the Minister of Justice's prisons and jails to find the hungry and cold and give food and clothing; replace heavy fetters with light bonds."

sentences.zh: 」是歲，郡鎮十八水旱，人饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: That year, eighteen commanderies and garrisons suffered flood or drought; the people were hungry; an edict opened granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year eighteen commanderies and posts suffered flood or drought; granaries were opened.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕、悉萬斤等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Rouran, Xiwenjin, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Rouran, Xiwenjin, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙卯，南巡。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, on the day yimao in the first month, a southern tour began.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the first month of year five a southern tour began.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，至中山，親見高年，問人疾苦。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, he reached Zhongshan, personally saw the aged, and inquired into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day he reached Zhongshan, saw the aged in person, and asked after suffering.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯朔，大赦。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day xinmao, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the first of the second month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜孝悌力田孤貧不能自存者，谷帛各有差。

translations.literal: The filial, brotherly, and strong in fieldwork, and the orphaned and poor who could not support themselves, were given grain and cloth in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The filial, brotherly, and strong in fieldwork, and orphans and poor who could not support themselves, received grain and cloth in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 免宮人之老者，還其親。

translations.literal: Elderly palace women were released and returned to their kin.
translations.idiomatic: Elderly palace women were released to their kin.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，至信都，存問如中山。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, he reached Xin Du and inquired and cared for the people as at Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day he reached Xin Du and cared for the people as at Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，還中山。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, he returned to Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day he returned to Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，講武於唐水之陽。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, military exercises were held on the south bank of the Tang River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day military exercises were held on the south bank of the Tang River.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 沙門法秀謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: The Buddhist monk Faxiu plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The monk Faxiu plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 假梁郡王嘉大破齊，俘獲三萬餘口，送京師。

translations.literal: Acting Prince of Liang Commandery Jia inflicted a great defeat on Qi, capturing more than thirty thousand persons and sending them to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Prince of Liang Commandery Jia crushed Qi, took more than thirty thousand captives, and sent them to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉朔，幸肆州。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the first day xinyou, the emperor visited Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the first of the third month, the emperor visited Si Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，講武於雲水之陽。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, military exercises were held on the south bank of the Yun River.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day military exercises were held on the south bank of the Yun River.

sentences.zh: 所經考察守宰，黜陟之。

translations.literal: Wherever he passed, he examined and promoted or demoted the prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: Along the route he examined magistrates and promoted or demoted them.

sentences.zh: 己巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「法秀妖詐亂常，妄說符瑞。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Faxiu practiced demonic fraud and disturbed the norms, falsely proclaiming portents."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Faxiu practiced demonic fraud, disturbed order, and falsely proclaimed portents."

sentences.zh: 蘭臺御史張求等一百餘人招結奴隸，謀為大逆。

translations.literal: More than a hundred men including Palace Secretary Zhang Qiu recruited slaves and plotted great treason.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred men including Palace Secretary Zhang Qiu recruited slaves and plotted great treason.

sentences.zh: 有司科以族誅，誠合刑憲。

translations.literal: The authorities judged them worthy of execution of the clan by law, which truly accorded with statute.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities judged clan execution, which truly matched statute.

sentences.zh: 但矜愚重命，猶所不忍。

translations.literal: Yet pitying folly and valuing life, this was still something we could not bear.
translations.idiomatic: Yet pitying folly and valuing life, we could not bear it.

sentences.zh: 其五族者降止同祖，三族止一門，門誅止身。

translations.literal: For the five clans the penalty was reduced to execution of the same ancestral line; for three clans, to one gate; for gate execution, guilt stopped with the person himself.
translations.idiomatic: For five clans punishment was reduced to the same ancestral line; for three clans, to one gate; for gate execution, only the offender himself.

sentences.zh: 」夏四月己亥，行幸方山。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jihai, the emperor traveled to Fang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fourth month of summer the emperor went to Fang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 建永固石室，於山立碑焉。

translations.literal: The Eternal Firmness stone chamber was built, and a stele was erected on the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The Eternal Firmness stone chamber was built and a stele set up on the mountain.

sentences.zh: 銘太皇太后終制於金冊。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager's final regulations were inscribed on a golden book.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager's final regulations were inscribed on a golden book.

sentences.zh: 又起鑒玄殿。

translations.literal: The Jianxuan Hall was also built.
translations.idiomatic: The Jianxuan Hall was also raised.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以旱故，詔所在掩骸骨，祈禱神祗。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, because of drought an edict ordered that exposed bones be buried wherever found and prayers be offered to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, for drought, exposed bones were to be buried and prayers offered to the spirits.

sentences.zh: 任城王雲薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Rencheng Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Rencheng Yun died.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲戌，大赦。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year, on the day jiaxu in the first month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the first month of year six a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，詔以靈丘郡土既褊塉，又諸州路沖，復其人租十五年。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinmao, an edict said that because the soil of Lingqiu Commandery was narrow and poor and the routes of the provinces were congested, its people's rent was remitted for fifteen years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the second month an edict remitted Lingqiu Commandery's rent for fifteen years because the land was poor and routes congested.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，白蘭王吐谷渾翼世以誣罔伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Bai Lan King Tuyuhun Yishi was executed for false accusation.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Bai Lan King Tuyuhun Yishi was executed for false accusation.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔曰：「蕭道成逆亂江淮，戎旗頻舉。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict said: "Xiao Daocheng rebelled and threw the Huai and Jiang into disorder; military banners have been raised repeatedly."
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict said: "Xiao Daocheng rebelled and threw Huai and Jiang into disorder; armies have marched again and again."

sentences.zh: 七州之人既有征運之勞，深乖輕徭之義，其復常調三年。

translations.literal: The people of the seven provinces already bear the labor of campaigns, which deeply violates the meaning of light levies; their regular taxes are remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: The seven provinces already bear campaign labor, which violates light levies; their regular taxes are remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，賜王公已下清勤著稱者，谷帛有差。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, princes, dukes, and those below who were noted for purity and diligence were given grain and cloth in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day princes, dukes, and men below noted for purity and diligence received grain and cloth in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，幸獸圈。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengchen, the emperor visited the animal park.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the third month the emperor visited the animal park.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「武狼猛暴，食肉殘生，從今勿復捕貢。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Martial wolves are fierce and violent, killing living things for meat; from now on do not capture them for tribute."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Martial wolves are fierce and kill for meat; from now on do not capture them for tribute."

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，幸武州山石窟寺，賜貧老衣服。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, he visited the cave temple on Wuzhou Mountain and gave clothing to the poor and aged.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day he visited the cave temple on Wuzhou Mountain and gave clothes to the poor and aged.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊高祖殂。

translations.literal: That month, the founding emperor of Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qi's founding emperor died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，賜畿內鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，粟帛各有差秋七月，發州郡五萬人修靈丘道。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiachen, the orphaned, widowed, and solitary within the capital who could not support themselves were given grain and cloth in varying amounts. In the seventh month of autumn, fifty thousand men from the provinces were levied to repair the Lingqiu road.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the fourth month of summer orphans, widows, and solitaries in the capital who could not support themselves received grain and cloth in varying amounts. In the seventh month of autumn fifty thousand men from the provinces were levied to repair the Lingqiu road.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未朔，分遣大使巡行天下遭水之處，丐其租賦，貧儉不自存者，賜以粟帛。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day guiwei, envoys were dispatched separately to tour the realm where flood had struck, remit rents and taxes, and give grain and cloth to the poor who could not support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the first of the eighth month, separate envoys toured flood-struck regions, remitted rents, and gave grain and cloth to the poor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，罷山澤禁。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, prohibitions on mountains and marshes were lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day prohibitions on mountains and marshes were lifted.

sentences.zh: 九月辛酉，以氐楊後起為武都王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinyou, the Di chieftain Yang Hou was appointed Prince of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the ninth month the Di chieftain Yang Hou was made Prince of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 是歲，地豆于、吐谷渾等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Didouyu, Tuyuhun, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Didouyu, Tuyuhun, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月庚申，詔曰：「朕每思知百姓疾苦以增修寬政，故具問守宰苛虐之狀於州郡使者。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventh year, on the day gengshen in the first month, an edict said: "We often think to know the people's hardships in order to broaden benevolent government, and therefore questioned the provincial and commandery envoys in detail on the cruelty of prefects and magistrates."
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the first month of year seven an edict said: "We often seek to know the people's hardships to broaden benevolent rule, and therefore asked provincial envoys in detail about cruel magistrates."

sentences.zh: 今秀孝計掾對多不實，甚乖朕虛求之意。

translations.literal: Now the xiucai and jiyuan in their replies were mostly untrue, greatly betraying our purpose in seeking honestly.
translations.idiomatic: Now the xiucai and jiyuan mostly answered untruthfully, greatly betraying our wish for honest answers.

sentences.zh: 宜案以大辟，明罔上必誅。

translations.literal: They should be judged by the great execution, making clear that deceiving the throne must be punished.
translations.idiomatic: They should be judged by capital punishment, making clear that deceiving the throne must be punished.

sentences.zh: 然情猶未忍。

translations.literal: Yet our hearts still could not bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet our hearts still could not bear it.

sentences.zh: 可恕罪聽歸，申下天下，使知後犯無恕。

translations.literal: Their crimes may be pardoned and they sent home; this is proclaimed throughout the realm so that later offenders will not be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: Their crimes may be pardoned and they sent home; this is proclaimed so later offenders will not be forgiven.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，詔青、齊、光、東徐四州戶，運倉粟一十萬石送瑕丘、瑯邪，復租算一年。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict ordered the households of the four provinces of Qing, Qi, Guang, and eastern Xu each to transport one hundred thousand shi of granary grain to Xiaqiu and Langye, and their rent and labor levies were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the four provinces Qing, Qi, Guang, and eastern Xu were told to transport one hundred thousand shi of grain to Xiaqiu and Langye, and rent and labor were remitted one year.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，以冀、定二州饑，詔郡縣為粥於路以食之，又弛關津之禁。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiaxu, because Ji and Ding provinces were hungry, an edict ordered commanderies and counties to set out porridge on the roads for food and relaxed pass and ford prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the third month, with Ji and Ding hungry, commanderies and counties set out porridge on the roads and passes were opened.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，幸崞山，賜所過鰥寡不能自存者衣服粟帛。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengzi, the emperor visited Guo Mountain and gave clothing, grain, and cloth to widowers and widows along the route who could not support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the fourth month of summer the emperor visited Guo Mountain and gave clothes, grain, and cloth to widowers and widows who could not support themselves.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸丑，皇子生，大赦。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day guichou, a prince was born and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the intercalary month a prince was born and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 六月，定州上言，為粥所活九十四萬七千餘口。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Ding Province reported that 947,000-odd persons were kept alive by the porridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Ding Province reported that 947,000-odd persons were kept alive by the porridge.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，詔假員外散騎常侍李彪使於齊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiashen, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Li Biao envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the seventh month of autumn Acting Staff Officer Li Biao was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 改封濟南王羅拔為趙郡王。

translations.literal: Prince of Ji'nan Luo Ba was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ji'nan Luo Ba was transferred and enfeoffed Prince of Zhao Commandery.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，詔求讜言。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renyin, an edict sought forthright counsel.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the ninth month an edict sought forthright counsel.

sentences.zh: 冀州上言，為粥所活七十五萬一千七百餘口。

translations.literal: Ji Province reported that 751,700-odd persons were kept alive by the porridge.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Province reported that 751,700-odd persons were kept alive by the porridge.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，皇信堂成。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuwu, the Huangxin Hall was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the tenth month of winter the Huangxin Hall was finished.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛丑，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinchou, men from Qi came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eleventh month Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day yisi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the first of the twelfth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔曰：「夏、殷不嫌一族之婚，周世始絕同姓之娶。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, an edict said: "Xia and Yin did not shrink from marriage within one clan; Zhou first ended marriage between those of the same surname."
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict said: "Xia and Yin did not shrink from marriage within one clan; Zhou first ended marriage between those of the same surname."

sentences.zh: 斯皆教隨時設，政因事改者也。

translations.literal: These are all teachings set according to the times and government changed according to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: These are teachings set according to the times and government changed according to affairs.

sentences.zh: 皇運初基，日不暇給，古風遺樸，未遑厘改。

translations.literal: When the imperial fortune was first founded, days allowed no leisure; ancient ways and surviving simplicity were not yet reformed.
translations.idiomatic: When the dynasty was first founded there was no leisure; ancient ways were not yet reformed.

sentences.zh: 自今悉禁絕之，有犯者以不道論。

translations.literal: From now on all such marriages are utterly forbidden; offenders are judged for treason.
translations.idiomatic: From now on all such marriages are forbidden; offenders are judged for treason.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，開林慮山禁，與人共之。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the prohibition on Linyu Mountain was opened and shared with the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the prohibition on Linyu Mountain was opened and shared with the people.

sentences.zh: 州鎮十三饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: Thirteen provinces and garrisons suffered famine; an edict opened granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen provinces and posts suffered famine; granaries were opened.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月，詔隴西公琛、尚書陸睿為東西二道大使，褒善罰惡。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year, in the first month, an edict appointed Duke of Longxi Chen and Minister of Works Lu Rui as eastern and western route grand envoys to praise the good and punish the wicked.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year eight Duke of Longxi Chen and Minister of Works Lu Rui were named eastern and western grand envoys to praise the good and punish the wicked.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己卯，詔振賜河南七州戍兵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day jimao, an edict granted relief to garrison soldiers of the seven provinces south of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the fifth month of summer the seven provinces south of the river received relief for garrison soldiers.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔員外散騎常侍李彪使於齊。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Li Biao envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Acting Staff Officer Li Biao was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，詔曰：「置官班祿，行之尚矣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingmao, an edict said: "Establishing official ranks and salaries has long been practiced."
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the sixth month an edict said: "Establishing official ranks and salaries has long been practiced."

sentences.zh: 自中原喪亂，茲制中絕。

translations.literal: Since the turmoil in the Central Plains this system was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Since turmoil in the Central Plains this system was cut off.

sentences.zh: 先朝因循，未遑厘改。

translations.literal: The former court followed old ways and had not yet reformed.
translations.idiomatic: The former court followed old ways and had not yet reformed.

sentences.zh: 朕顧憲章舊典，始班俸祿，罷諸商人，以簡人事。

translations.literal: We look back to the old statutes and now distribute salaries, abolishing all merchant levies to simplify human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: We look back to old statutes and now distribute salaries, abolishing merchant levies to simplify affairs.

sentences.zh: 戶增調三匹、谷二斛九斗，以為官司之祿。

translations.literal: Each household's levy was increased by three bolts of silk and 2.9 dou of grain for official salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Each household's levy was increased by three bolts of silk and 2.9 dou of grain for official salaries.

sentences.zh: 均預調為二匹之賦，即兼商用。

translations.literal: The uniform advance levy was made two bolts per household, which also covered commercial use.
translations.idiomatic: The uniform advance levy was two bolts per household, which also covered commercial use.

sentences.zh: 雖有一時之煩，終克永逸之益。

translations.literal: Though there is temporary trouble at first, in the end lasting ease is achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Though there is temporary trouble at first, in the end lasting ease is achieved.

sentences.zh: 祿行之後，贓滿一匹者死。

translations.literal: After salaries were instituted, those guilty of bribery of one bolt or more were put to death.
translations.idiomatic: After salaries were instituted, bribery of one bolt or more was capital.

sentences.zh: 變法改度，宜為更始，其大赦天下，與之惟新。

translations.literal: Changing laws and measures should mark a new beginning; a general amnesty was proclaimed for the realm to begin anew.
translations.idiomatic: Changing laws and measures should mark a new beginning; a general amnesty proclaimed the realm anew.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，武州水壞人居。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, flood at Wuzhou destroyed people's dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day flood at Wuzhou destroyed dwellings.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲辰，詔以班制俸祿，更興刑書，寬猛未允，人或異議。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day jiachen, an edict said that because salaries were instituted and penal law renewed, whether lenient or severe was not yet settled and men had differing views.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the eighth month of autumn an edict said that with salaries instituted and penal law renewed, lenience and severity were not yet settled and men differed.

sentences.zh: 制百辟卿士工商吏人各上便宜，勿有所隱。

translations.literal: All ministers, scholar-officials, artisans, merchants, clerks, and commoners were to submit what was expedient, concealing nothing.
translations.idiomatic: All ministers, scholars, artisans, merchants, clerks, and commoners were to submit what was expedient, concealing nothing.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiawu, men from Qi came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the ninth month Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔俸制十月為首，每季一請。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict ordered that the salary system begin with the tenth month, requested each season.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the salary system was to begin with the tenth month, requested each season.

sentences.zh: 於是內外百官，受祿有差。

translations.literal: Thereupon civil and military officials within and without received salaries in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon civil and military officials within and without received salaries in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未，詔員外散騎常侍李彪使於齊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day yiwei, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Li Biao envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the eleventh month of winter Acting Staff Officer Li Biao was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 十二月，州鎮十五水旱，人饑，詔使者開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered flood or drought; the people were hungry; an edict ordered envoys to open granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month fifteen provinces and posts suffered flood or drought; envoys opened granaries.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Rouran, Goguryeo, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Goguryeo, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月戊寅，詔禁圖讖秘緯及名《孔子閉房記》，留者以大辟論。

translations.literal: In the spring of the ninth year, on the day wuyin in the first month, an edict forbade charts, prophecies, secret weft texts, and books titled Records of Confucius in the Inner Chamber; those who kept them were judged by the great execution.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the first month of year nine charts, prophecies, secret weft texts, and books titled Records of Confucius in the Inner Chamber were forbidden; keepers faced capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 又諸巫覡假稱神鬼，妄說吉凶，及委巷諸非墳典所裁者，嚴加禁斷。

translations.literal: All shamans and sorcerers who falsely claimed spirits and ghosts and spoke rashly of fortune and misfortune, and whatever back-alley matters not sanctioned by the canonical tomes, were strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Shamans who falsely claimed spirits and spoke rashly of fortune, and back-alley matters not in the canonical tomes, were strictly forbidden.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大饗群臣於太華殿，班賜皇誥。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, a great feast was held for the ministers in Taihua Hall and imperial mandates were distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day a great feast was held for ministers in Taihua Hall and imperial mandates distributed.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，制皇子封王者、皇孫皇曾孫紹封者、皇女封者，歲祿各有差。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jihai, regulations were made that enfeoffed princes, imperial grandsons and great-grandsons who succeeded to enfeoffment, and enfeoffed imperial daughters each received annual salaries in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the second month enfeoffed princes, imperial grandsons and great-grandsons who succeeded, and enfeoffed imperial daughters received annual salaries in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 封廣陽王建第二子嘉為廣陽王。

translations.literal: The second son of Prince of Guangyang Jian, Jia, was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangyang.
translations.idiomatic: The second son of Prince of Guangyang Jian, Jia, was enfeoffed Prince of Guangyang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔百辟卿士工商吏人各上書極諫，靡有所隱。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict ordered all ministers, scholar-officials, artisans, merchants, clerks, and commoners to submit memorials with utmost remonstrance, concealing nothing.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day all ministers, scholars, artisans, merchants, clerks, and commoners were told to remonstrate to the utmost, concealing nothing.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，封皇弟禧為咸陽王，幹為河南王，羽為廣陵王，雍為潁川王，勰為始平王，詳為北海王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingshen, the emperor's younger brother Xi was enfeoffed as Prince of Xianyang, Gan as Prince of Henan, Yu as Prince of Guangling, Yong as Prince of Yingchuan, Xie as Prince of Shiping, and Xiang as Prince of Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the third month the emperor's younger brother Xi was enfeoffed Prince of Xianyang, Gan Prince of Henan, Yu Prince of Guangling, Yong Prince of Yingchuan, Xie Prince of Shiping, and Xiang Prince of Beihai.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, men from Qi came on embassy.
