translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午朔，新作諸門。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day bingwu, the various gates were newly built.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the first of the seventh month of autumn, the various gates were newly built.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣使拜宕昌王梁彌機兄子彌承為宕昌王。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, an envoy was sent to invest Liang Miji's nephew Mi Cheng as King of Dangchang in succession to Liang Miji.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day an envoy invested Mi Cheng, nephew of Liang Miji, as King of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，詔曰：「數州災水，饑饉薦臻，致有賣鬻男女者。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengshen, an edict said: "Several provinces have suffered flood disasters; famine has come in succession, leading to the sale of men and women."
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the eighth month an edict said: "Several provinces have suffered flood; famine has come in succession, leading to the sale of men and women."

sentences.zh: 天譴在予一人，百姓橫罹艱毒。

translations.literal: Heaven's reproof rests on us alone; the people have met hardship and poison.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's reproof rests on us alone; the people have met hardship and poison.

sentences.zh: 今自太和六年已來，買定、冀、幽、相四州饑人良口者，盡還所親。

translations.literal: From the sixth year of Taihe onward, good persons among the hungry of the four provinces of Ding, Ji, You, and Xiang who were bought shall all be returned to their kin.
translations.idiomatic: From Taihe year six onward, good persons among the hungry of Ding, Ji, You, and Xiang who were bought shall all be returned to their kin.

sentences.zh: 雖娉為妻妾，遇之非理，情不樂者，亦離之。

translations.literal: Even if taken as wives or concubines, if treated unreasonably and their hearts are not willing, they are also to be separated.
translations.idiomatic: Even if taken as wives or concubines, if treated unreasonably and unwilling, they are also to be separated.

sentences.zh: 」冬十月丁未，詔使者循行州郡，與牧守均給天下之田，還受以生死為斷。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingwei, an edict ordered envoys to tour the provinces and commanderies and with prefects and governors evenly distribute fields throughout the realm, receiving and returning them with life and death as the limit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the tenth month of winter envoys toured provinces and commanderies and with magistrates evenly distributed fields throughout the realm, with life and death as the limit.

sentences.zh: 勸課農桑，興富人之本。

translations.literal: They were to encourage farming and sericulture, the root of enriching the people.
translations.idiomatic: They were to encourage farming and sericulture, the root of enriching the people.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，司徒、魏郡王陳建薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Minister of Works Prince of Wei Commandery Chen Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Minister of Works Prince of Wei Commandery Chen Jian died.

sentences.zh: 詔員外散騎常侍李彪使於齊。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Li Biao envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Staff Officer Li Biao was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，以侍中、淮南王他為司徒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yimao, Attendant-in-ordinary Prince of Huainan Ta was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the twelfth month Attendant-in-ordinary Prince of Huainan Ta became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師及州鎮十三水旱傷稼。

translations.literal: That year, the capital and thirteen provinces and garrisons suffered flood or drought that injured the crops.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital and thirteen provinces and posts suffered flood or drought that injured crops.

sentences.zh: 宕昌、高麗、吐谷渾等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Dangchang, Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Dangchang, Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月癸亥朔，帝始服袞冕，朝饗萬國。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year, on the first day guihai, the Emperor first wore the imperial robe and cap and held court to feast the myriad states.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the first of the tenth year, the Emperor first wore imperial robe and cap and held court to feast the myriad states.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，初立黨、里、鄰三長，定人戶籍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiaxu, the three chiefs of party, li, and neighbor were first established and household registers fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the second month the three chiefs of party, li, and neighbor were first established and household registers fixed.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengxu, men from Qi came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the third month Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，始制五等公服。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day xinyou, the five grades of public service dress were first instituted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the first of the fourth month of summer, the five grades of public service dress were first instituted.

sentences.zh: 甲子，帝初法服御輦祀西郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Emperor for the first time wore ritual robes, mounted the imperial carriage, and sacrificed at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Emperor for the first time wore ritual robes, mounted the imperial carriage, and sacrificed at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，名皇子曰恂，大赦。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yimao, the imperial son was named Xun and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the sixth month the imperial son was named Xun and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙亥，給尚書五等品爵已上朱衣玉佩大小組綬。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day yihai, Ministers of the Masters of Writing of the fifth rank and above were given vermilion robes, jade pendants, and great and small sash seals.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the eighth month of autumn Ministers of the Masters of Writing of the fifth rank and above received vermilion robes, jade pendants, and great and small sash seals.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，詔起明堂辟雍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinmao, an edict ordered the Bright Hall and Imperial Academy to be built.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the ninth month an edict ordered the Bright Hall and Imperial Academy built.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，有司議依故事配始祖於南郊。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guiyou, the relevant offices debated according to precedent enshrining the founding ancestor at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the tenth month of winter the relevant offices debated enshrining the founding ancestor at the southern suburb according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 十一月，議定州郡縣官依口給俸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, it was resolved that officials of provinces, commanderies, and counties should receive salaries according to population.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month it was resolved that officials of provinces, commanderies, and counties should receive salaries according to population.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，汝南、潁川饑，詔丐人田租，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day yiyou, Runan and Yingchuan were hungry; an edict remitted field rents and opened granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the twelfth month Runan and Yingchuan were hungry; rents were remitted and granaries opened.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、吐谷渾、勿吉等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Rouran, Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, Wuji, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, Wuji, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月丁亥朔，詔定樂章，非雅者除之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year, on the first day dinghai, an edict fixed the ritual music and removed what was not canonical.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the first of the eleventh year, an edict fixed ritual music and removed what was not canonical.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，肆州之雁門及代郡人饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiazi, the people of Yanmen in Si Province and Dai Commandery were hungry; an edict opened granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the second month Yanmen in Si and Dai were hungry; granaries were opened.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸巳，南平王渾薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day guisi, Prince of Nanping Hun died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the fifth month of summer Prince of Nanping Hun died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔復七廟子孫及外戚緦服已上，賦役無所與。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, an edict restored the descendants of the seven temples and maternal kin of distant-mourning rank and above to exemption from levies and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day descendants of the seven temples and maternal kin of distant-mourning rank and above were restored to exemption from levies and corvée.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，秦州人饑，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinsi, the people of Qin Province were hungry; an edict opened granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the sixth month Qin Province was hungry; granaries were opened.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，詔今年谷不登，聽人出關就食。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jichou, an edict said that because grain did not ripen this year, people were permitted to leave the passes to seek food.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the seventh month of autumn, with grain failing, people were permitted to leave the passes to seek food.

sentences.zh: 遣使者造籍，分遣去留，所在開倉振恤。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to compile registers, assign who should stay or go, and open granaries for relief wherever they were.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys compiled registers, assigned who should stay or go, and opened granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，蠕蠕犯塞，遣平原王陸睿討之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renshen, the Rouran raided the frontier; Prince of Pingyuan Lu Rui was sent to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the eighth month Rouran raided the frontier; Prince of Pingyuan Lu Rui was sent against them.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，大議北伐。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, a great debate was held on a northern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day a great debate was held on a northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷山北苑，以其地賜貧人。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the park north of the mountains was abolished and its land given to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the park north of the mountains was abolished and its land given to the poor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，詔罷起部無益之作，出宮人不執機杼者。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinwei, an edict abolished useless works of the Construction Office and released palace women who did not work the loom.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the tenth month of winter useless works of the Construction Office were abolished and palace women who did not weave were released.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔曰：「鄉飲之禮廢，則長幼之序亂。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, an edict said: "When the district drinking ceremony is abandoned, the order of elder and younger is disrupted."
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day an edict said: "When the district drinking ceremony is abandoned, the order of elder and younger is disrupted."

sentences.zh: 孟冬十月，人閑歲隙，宜於此時，導以德義。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, when men have leisure at year's end, it is fitting at this time to guide them with virtue and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, when men have leisure at year's end, it is fitting to guide them with virtue and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 可下諸州，黨、里之內，推賢而長者，教其里人父慈、子孝、兄友、弟順、夫和、妻柔。

translations.literal: All provinces are to be ordered that within each party and li the worthy and elder should teach the people filial fathers, filial sons, friendly elder brothers, obedient younger brothers, harmonious husbands, and gentle wives.
translations.idiomatic: All provinces were told that within each party and li the worthy and elder should teach filial fathers, filial sons, friendly brothers, obedient brothers, harmonious husbands, and gentle wives.

sentences.zh: 不率長教者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Those who do not follow the elders' teaching are to be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Those who do not follow the elders' teaching were to be reported by name.

sentences.zh: 」十一月丁未，詔罷尚方錦繡綾羅之工，百姓欲造，任之無禁。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, an edict abolished the Imperial Workshop's brocade, embroidery, gauze, and silk craftsmen; if commoners wish to make them, they may without prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Imperial Workshop's brocade, embroidery, gauze, and silk craftsmen were abolished; commoners might make them without prohibition.

sentences.zh: 其御府衣服金銀珠玉綾紬錦、太官雜器、太僕乘具、內庫弓矢，出其大半，班賫百官及京師人庶，下至工商皂隸，逮於六鎮戍士，各有差。

translations.literal: Imperial wardrobe clothing, gold, silver, pearls, jade, gauze, brocade, Grand Provision vessels, Grand Equipage transport, and inner treasury bows and arrows: more than half were taken out and distributed to officials and the people of the capital down to artisans, merchants, and bond servants, reaching the garrison soldiers of the six garrisons, each in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: More than half of imperial wardrobe, Grand Provision vessels, Grand Equipage transport, and inner treasury bows were distributed to officials and people of the capital down to artisans, merchants, bond servants, and the six garrisons' soldiers, each in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔今寒氣勁切，杖棰難任。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, an edict said: "Now the cold is severe and beating with rods is hard to bear."
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict said: "Now the cold is severe and beating with rods is hard to bear."

sentences.zh: 自今月至來年孟夏，不聽栲問罪人。

translations.literal: From this month until the first month of summer next year, the torture interrogation of criminals is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: From this month until the first month of summer next year, torture interrogation of criminals was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 又歲饑，輕囚宜速決了，無令薄罪久留獄犴。

translations.literal: Also, with famine this year, light offenders should be quickly decided and not left long in prison for petty crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Also, with famine this year, light offenders were to be quickly decided and not left long in prison.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔秘書丞李彪、著作郎崔光改析國記，依紀傳體。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered Secretariat Assistant Li Biao and Compilation Gentleman Cui Guang to reorganize the National Record according to annals-biography form.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Li Biao and Cui Guang were ordered to reorganize the National Record in annals-biography form.

sentences.zh: 是歲大饑，詔所在開倉振恤。

translations.literal: That year there was great famine; an edict ordered granaries opened for relief wherever found.
translations.idiomatic: That year there was great famine; granaries were opened wherever found.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾、高麗、悉萬斤等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, Xiwenjin, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, Xiwenjin, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月辛亥，祀圓丘，初備大駕。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year, on the first day xinhai, the Round Mound was sacrificed to and the full imperial escort was first prepared.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the first of the thirteenth year, the Round Mound was sacrificed to and the full imperial escort was first prepared.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，兗州人王伯恭聚眾勞山，自稱齊王，東萊鎮將孔伯孫討斬之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Wang Bogong of Yan Province gathered a crowd on Lao Mountain, proclaimed himself King of Qi, and was captured and beheaded by the garrison commander of Donglai, Kong Bosun.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Wang Bogong of Yan gathered men on Lao Mountain, called himself King of Qi, and was captured and beheaded by Donglai commander Kong Bosun.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，齊人寇邊，淮南太守王僧俊擊走之。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the men of Qi raided the frontier; Administrator of Huainan Wang Sengjun drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Qi raiders struck the frontier; Huainan administrator Wang Sengjun drove them off.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，引群臣訪政道得失損益之宜。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengzi, the ministers were summoned to discuss what was gained and lost in government and what should be increased or reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the second month ministers were summoned to discuss gains and losses in government.

sentences.zh: 三月，夏州刺史章武王彬以貪財削封。

translations.literal: In the third month, Prince of Zhangwu Bin, regional inspector of Xia Province, had his enfeoffment reduced for greed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Prince of Zhangwu Bin, regional inspector of Xia, had his enfeoffment reduced for greed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，詔曰：「升樓散物，以賫百姓，至使人馬騰踐，多有毀傷。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day dingchou, an edict said: "Scattering goods from towers to give to the people leads to horses and men trampling and much damage."
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the fourth month of summer an edict said: "Scattering goods from towers leads to horses and men trampling and much damage."

sentences.zh: 今可斷之。

translations.literal: This is now to be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: This is now to be stopped.

sentences.zh: 以本所費之物賜窮老貧獨者。

translations.literal: What would have been spent is to be given to the poor, aged, and solitary.
translations.idiomatic: What would have been spent is to be given to the poor, aged, and solitary.

sentences.zh: 」州鎮十五大饑，詔所在開倉振恤。

translations.literal: Fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered great famine; an edict ordered granaries opened for relief wherever found.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen provinces and posts suffered great famine; granaries were opened wherever found.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，祀方澤。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, the Square Pond was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the fifth month the Square Pond was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 六月，汝陰王天賜、南安王楨並坐贓賄，免為庶人。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Princes of Yiyin Tianci and Nan'an Zhen were both guilty of bribery and removed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Princes of Yiyin Tianci and Nan'an Zhen were both guilty of bribery and reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，立孔子廟於京師。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, a temple to Confucius was established in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn a temple to Confucius was established in the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，詔兼員外散騎常侍邢產使於齊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yihai, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Xing Chan envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the eighth month Acting Staff Officer Xing Chan was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 九月，出宮人賜北鎮人貧鰥者。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, palace women were released and given to poor widowers of the northern garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month palace women were given to poor widowers of the northern garrisons.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己未，安豐王猛薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day jiwei, Prince of Anfeng Meng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the eleventh month of winter Prince of Anfeng Meng died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，司空、河東王茍頹薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingzi, Minister of Works Prince of Hedong Gou Tui died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the twelfth month Minister of Works Prince of Hedong Gou Tui died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, men from Qi came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以尚書令尉元為司徒，左僕射穆亮為司空。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Minister of the Masters of Writing Wei Yuan was made Minister of Works, and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Mu Liang was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Minister of the Masters of Writing Wei Yuan became Minister of Works, and Left Vice Director Mu Liang became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、吐谷渾、陰平、中赤、武興、宕昌等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, Yinping, Zhongchi, Wuxing, Dangchang, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, Yinping, Zhongchi, Wuxing, Dangchang, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月己巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year, on the first day jisi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the first of the fourteenth year, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，初詔定起居註制。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuyin, an edict first fixed the system of the Diarist.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the third month the system of the Diarist was first fixed.

sentences.zh: 詔遣侍臣巡行州郡，問人疾苦。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched attendant ministers to tour the provinces and commanderies and inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant ministers were sent to tour provinces and commanderies and inquire into hardship.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，地豆于頻犯塞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Didouyu repeatedly raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Didouyu repeatedly raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，征西大將軍、陽平王熙擊走之。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, General Who Conquers the West Prince of Yangping Xi drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day General Who Conquers the West Prince of Yangping Xi drove them off.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔兼員外散騎常侍邢產使於頤齊。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Xing Chan envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Acting Staff Officer Xing Chan was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，庫莫奚犯塞，安州都將樓龍兒擊走之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiyou, Kumo Xi raided the frontier; Regional Commander of An Province Lou Long'er drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the fifth month Kumo Xi raided the frontier; An commander Lou Long'er drove them off.

sentences.zh: 沙門司馬禦惠自言聖王，謀破平原郡，禽獲伏誅。

translations.literal: The Buddhist monk Sima Yuhui proclaimed himself a sage king, plotted to seize Pingyuan Commandery, was captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: The monk Sima Yuhui called himself a sage king, plotted to seize Pingyuan, was captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，詔罷都牧雜制。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiachen, an edict abolished miscellaneous regulations of the Metropolitan Pasturage.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the seventh month of autumn miscellaneous regulations of the Metropolitan Pasturage were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔議國之行次。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict ordered debate on the order of sacrifices for the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month debate was ordered on the order of state sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，太皇太后馮氏崩。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guichou, Grand Empress Dowager Feng died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the ninth month Grand Empress Dowager Feng died.

sentences.zh: 詔聽籓鎮曾經內侍者，前後奔赴。

translations.literal: An edict permitted those of the frontier garrisons who had formerly served within to hurry thither before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Those of frontier garrisons who had formerly served within were permitted to hurry thither.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，詔將親侍龍輿，奉訣陵隧，諸常從之具，悉可停之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuchen, an edict said the emperor would personally attend the dragon carriage and take leave at the tomb passage; all usual attendants were to stop.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the tenth month of winter an edict said the emperor would personally attend the dragon carriage at the tomb; usual attendants were to stop.

sentences.zh: 其武衛之官，防侍如法。

translations.literal: Military guard officials were to attend and protect according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Military guard officials were to attend and protect according to law.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，葬文明太皇太后於永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Empress Dowager Wenming was buried at Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Empress Dowager Wenming was buried at Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，車駕謁永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the imperial carriage visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the emperor visited Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 群臣固請公除，帝不許。

translations.literal: The ministers firmly requested public removal of mourning garments; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers firmly requested public removal of mourning; the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕謁永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the imperial carriage visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the emperor visited Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，帝居廬，引見群僚於太和殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Emperor dwelt in the mourning hut and received the officials in Taihe Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor dwelt in the mourning hut and received officials in Taihe Hall.

sentences.zh: 太尉、東陽王丕等據權制固請。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Prince of Dongyang Pi and others, relying on statutory authority, firmly requested.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Prince of Dongyang Pi and others, relying on statute, firmly requested.

sentences.zh: 帝引古禮往復，群臣乃止。

translations.literal: The Emperor cited ancient rites back and forth; the ministers then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor cited ancient rites back and forth; the ministers then stopped.

sentences.zh: 京兆王太興有罪，免官削爵。

translations.literal: Prince of Jingzhao Tai Xing was guilty of crime, removed from office and stripped of rank.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jingzhao Tai Xing, guilty of crime, was removed from office and stripped of rank.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「公卿屢依金冊遺旨，中代權制，式請過葬即吉。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The dukes and ministers repeatedly rely on the golden book's final testament and the provisional systems of middle antiquity, formally requesting that after burial one immediately return to auspicious rites."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Dukes and ministers repeatedly rely on the golden book's testament and middle antiquity's provisional systems, requesting auspicious rites immediately after burial."

sentences.zh: 朕思遵遠古，終三年之制。

translations.literal: We think to follow remote antiquity and complete the three-year regulation.
translations.idiomatic: We think to follow remote antiquity and complete the three-year regulation.

sentences.zh: 依禮，既虞卒哭。

translations.literal: According to rites, after the offering and end of wailing.
translations.idiomatic: According to rites, after the offering and end of wailing.

sentences.zh: 此月二十一日授服，以葛易麻。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of this month mourning garments are received, replacing hemp with ramie.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first of this month mourning garments are received, replacing hemp with ramie.

sentences.zh: 既以衰服在上，公卿不得獨釋於下，故於朕之授服，變從練禮已下復為節降。

translations.literal: Since the mourning garment is above, the dukes and ministers cannot alone remove theirs below; therefore at our receiving garments the change follows from the practice after the end of wailing, returning to graduated reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Since the mourning garment is above, dukes and ministers cannot alone remove theirs below; at our receiving garments the change follows graduated reduction after wailing ends.

sentences.zh: 斟酌古今，以制厥衷。

translations.literal: Weighing ancient and modern, we regulate our inner intent.
translations.idiomatic: Weighing ancient and modern, we regulate our inner intent.

sentences.zh: 且取遺旨速除之一端，粗申臣子罔極之巨痛。

translations.literal: Moreover we take one strand of the testament's swift removal, roughly expressing the ministers' measureless grief.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover we take one strand of the testament's swift removal, roughly expressing ministers' measureless grief.

sentences.zh: 」癸未，詔曰：「朕遠遵古式，欲終三年之禮。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, an edict said: "We follow remote ancient forms and wish to complete the three-year rites."
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day an edict said: "We follow remote ancient forms and wish to complete the three-year rites."

sentences.zh: 百辟群臣，據金冊顧命，將奪朕心，從先朝之制。

translations.literal: The hundred ranks and ministers, relying on the golden book and testament, would seize our heart and follow the former court's system.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred ranks and ministers, relying on the golden book and testament, would seize our heart and follow the former court's system.

sentences.zh: 朕仰惟金冊，俯自推省，取諸二衷，不許眾議。

translations.literal: We look up at the golden book and reflect below, taking from both inner intents and not permitting the multitude's debate.
translations.idiomatic: We look up at the golden book and reflect below, taking from both inner intents and not permitting debate.

sentences.zh: 以衰服過期，終四節之慕。

translations.literal: With mourning garments past term, we complete mourning through all four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: With mourning garments past term, we complete mourning through all four seasons.

sentences.zh: 又奉遵聖訓，聿修誥旨，不敢暗默自居，以曠機政。

translations.literal: Moreover we respectfully follow the sage's instruction and repair the edict's intent, not daring to dwell in secret silence and neglect government.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover we respectfully follow the sage's instruction and repair the edict's intent, not daring to neglect government in silence.

sentences.zh: 庶不愆遺令之意，差展哀慕之情。

translations.literal: We hope not to violate the testament's intent and somewhat unfold the feeling of mourning and longing.
translations.idiomatic: We hope not to violate the testament's intent and somewhat unfold mourning and longing.

sentences.zh: 並下州鎮，長至、三元，絕告慶之禮。

translations.literal: This is proclaimed to the provinces and garrisons: at winter solstice and the three first days, all congratulatory rites are ended.
translations.idiomatic: This was proclaimed to provinces and garrisons: at winter solstice and the three first days, congratulatory rites ended.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，車駕謁永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the imperial carriage visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the emperor visited Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，詔內外職人先朝班次及諸方雜客，冬至之日，盡聽入臨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiayin, an edict ordered that civil and military personnel of former court ranks and miscellaneous guests from all regions on the day of winter solstice might all come to mourn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the eleventh month civil and military personnel of former ranks and guests from all regions on winter solstice might all come to mourn.

sentences.zh: 三品已下衰服者，至夕復臨。

translations.literal: Those of the third rank and below in mourning garments came again in the evening.
translations.idiomatic: Those of the third rank and below in mourning garments came again in the evening.

sentences.zh: 其餘唯旦臨而已。

translations.literal: The rest came only at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: The rest came only at dawn.

sentences.zh: 其拜哭之節，一依別儀。

translations.literal: The protocol of bowing and weeping followed separate regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol of bowing and weeping followed separate regulations.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, men from Qi came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，詔依準丘井之式，遣使與州郡宣行條制。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renwu, an edict ordered that according to the well-field model envoys be sent with the provinces and commanderies to proclaim and enact the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the twelfth month envoys were sent with provinces and commanderies to proclaim regulations according to the well-field model.

sentences.zh: 隱口漏丁，即聽附實。

translations.literal: Those who concealed population or omitted conscripts might attach to true registers.
translations.idiomatic: Those who concealed population or omitted conscripts might attach to true registers.

sentences.zh: 若朋附豪勢，陵抑孤獨，罪有常刑。

translations.literal: If they attached to powerful clans and oppressed the orphaned and solitary, the usual punishments applied.
translations.idiomatic: If they attached to powerful clans and oppressed the orphaned and solitary, the usual punishments applied.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、宕昌、武興、陰平、高麗等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Wuxing, Yinping, Goguryeo, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Dangchang, Wuxing, Yinping, Goguryeo, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月丁巳，帝始聽政於皇信東室。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifteenth year, on the day dingsi in the first month, the Emperor first heard government in the eastern chamber of Huangxin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the first month of the fifteenth year the Emperor first heard government in Huangxin's eastern chamber.

sentences.zh: 初分置左右史官。

translations.literal: The offices of left and right historians were first separately established.
translations.idiomatic: The offices of left and right historians were first separately established.

sentences.zh: 癸亥晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, guihai, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，齊人來聘。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jichou, men from Qi came on embassy.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the second month Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，車駕謁永固陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiachen, the imperial carriage visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the third month the emperor visited Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，帝始進蔬食。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guihai, the Emperor first took vegetable food.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the fourth month of summer the Emperor first took vegetable food.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，謁永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, he visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day he visited Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 自正月不雨至於癸酉，有司奏祈百神。

translations.literal: From the first month without rain until guiyou, the relevant offices memorialized praying to the hundred spirits.
translations.idiomatic: From the first month without rain until guiyou the relevant offices memorialized praying to the hundred spirits.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「何宜四氣未周，便行禮事，唯當考躬責己，以待天譴。

translations.literal: An edict said: "How can we perform ritual when the four seasons are not complete? We should examine ourselves and await heaven's reproof."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "How can we perform ritual when the four seasons are not complete? We should examine ourselves and await heaven's reproof."

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，詔員外散騎常侍李彪使於齊。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Li Biao envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Acting Staff Officer Li Biao was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，經始明堂，改營太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, construction of the Bright Hall began and the Grand Temple was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day construction of the Bright Hall began and the Grand Temple was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，議改律令。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jihai, revision of laws and statutes was debated.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the fifth month revision of laws and statutes was debated.

sentences.zh: 於東明觀折疑獄。

sentences.zh: 丙子，以吐谷渾伏連籌為其國王。

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Tuyuhun Fu Lianchou was made king of that state.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，蠲大司馬安定王休、太保齊郡王簡朔望之朝。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the first-and-fifteenth court attendance of Grand Marshal Prince of Anding Xiu and Grand Mentor Prince of Qi Commandery Jian was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day first-and-fifteenth court attendance of Grand Marshal Prince of Anding Xiu and Grand Mentor Prince of Qi Commandery Jian was remitted.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，詔賜議律令之官各有差。

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the second month officials who debated laws received rewards in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕始籍田於都南。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the imperial carriage first plowed the sacred field south of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the emperor first plowed the sacred field south of the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，改作後宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuchen, the rear palace was rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the third month the rear palace was rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，立皇后馮氏。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wuxu, Empress Feng was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the fourth month of summer Empress Feng was established.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊直閣將軍蠻酋田益宗率部落內屬。

translations.literal: That month, the Qi officer Tian Yizong, a barbarian chieftain of the direct attendants, led his tribe to submit.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qi officer Tian Yizong, a barbarian chieftain, led his tribe to submit.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，宴四廟子孫於宣文堂，帝親與之齒，行家人禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renxu, descendants of the four temples were feasted in Xuwen Hall; the Emperor personally matched ages with them and performed family rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fifth month descendants of the four temples were feasted in Xuwen Hall; the Emperor matched ages and performed family rites.

sentences.zh: 甲子，帝臨朝堂，引見公卿以下。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Emperor attended court, summoned dukes and ministers and those below,
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Emperor attended court and summoned dukes, ministers, and those below,

sentences.zh: 決疑政，錄囚徒。

translations.literal: decided doubtful government, and recorded prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: decided doubtful government and recorded prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以旱徹膳。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, because of drought, meals were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, for drought, meals were reduced.

sentences.zh: 襄陽蠻酋雷婆思等率其部內徙，居於太和川。

translations.literal: The barbarian chieftains of Xiangyang, Lei Posi and others, led their tribes to relocate and dwell on the Taihe River.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang chieftains Lei Posi and others led their tribes to relocate on the Taihe River.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the first day gengchen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the first of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，帝將南伐，詔造河橋。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Emperor was about to campaign south; an edict ordered a bridge built over the river.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, with a southern campaign planned, a river bridge was ordered built.

sentences.zh: 乙未，講武。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, military exercises were held.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day military exercises were held.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔曰：「比百秩雖陳，事典未敘。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict said: "Though the hundred ranks have been set forth, the canon of offices is not yet ordered."
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict said: "Though the hundred ranks have been set forth, the canon of offices is not yet ordered."

sentences.zh: 自八元樹位，躬加省覽，作職員令二十一卷。

translations.literal: Since the eight yuan were established in office, we have personally reviewed and made the Staff Duties Order in twenty-one scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Since the eight yuan were established, we personally reviewed and made the Staff Duties Order in twenty-one scrolls.

sentences.zh: 事迫戎期，未善周悉，須待軍回，更論所闕。

translations.literal: Matters pressed by the military season and are not yet fully complete; we must wait until the army returns to discuss what is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Matters pressed by the military season are not yet complete; we must wait until the army returns to discuss what is lacking.

translations.literal: For the present it may be issued for execution outside.
translations.idiomatic: For the present it may be issued for execution.

sentences.zh: 」立皇子恂為皇太子。

translations.literal: The imperial son Xun was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial son Xun was established as crown prince.

translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the seventh month of autumn, with the crown prince established, men who had become heirs for their fathers received one rank as gongshi.

sentences.zh: 曾為吏屬者爵二級，為上造。

translations.literal: Those who had served as clerks received two ranks, making them shangzao.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had served as clerks received two ranks as shangzao.

sentences.zh: 鰥寡孤獨不能自存者，人粟五斛。

translations.literal: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves received five hu of grain per person.
translations.idiomatic: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary who could not support themselves received five hu of grain each.

sentences.zh: 戊午，中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the court and the realm were placed on alert.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the court and realm were placed on alert.

sentences.zh: 是月，齊武帝殂。

translations.literal: That month, Emperor Wu of Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Emperor Wu of Qi died.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，三老山陽郡公尉元薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiyou, the three elders Duke of Shanyang Commandery Wei Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the eighth month the three elders Duke of Shanyang Wei Yuan died.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，車駕類於上帝，遂臨尉元喪。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the imperial carriage offered to the Supreme Lord and then attended Wei Yuan's funeral.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the emperor offered to the Supreme Lord and then attended Wei Yuan's funeral.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，帝辭永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Emperor took leave at Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor took leave at Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 己丑，發京師南伐，步騎三十餘萬。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the capital was left for the southern campaign with more than three hundred thousand infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the capital was left for the southern campaign with more than three hundred thousand foot and horse.

sentences.zh: 太尉丕奏請以宮人從，詔以臨戎不語內事，不許。

translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Pi asked that palace women accompany the army; an edict refused, saying on campaign one does not speak of inner affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，車駕至肆州。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the imperial carriage reached Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the emperor reached Si Province.

sentences.zh: 人年七十已上，賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Those aged seventy and above were granted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Those aged seventy and above received one rank.

sentences.zh: 路見眇跛，停駕親問，賜衣食，復終事。

translations.literal: Seeing the blind and lame along the road, he halted the carriage and asked in person, giving clothing and food and remitting their corvée for life.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the blind and lame along the road, he halted, asked in person, gave clothing and food, and remitted their corvée for life.

sentences.zh: 戊申，幸并州，親見高年，問疾苦。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, he visited Bing Province, personally saw the aged, and inquired into hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day he visited Bing Province, saw the aged in person, and asked after hardship.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，詔兼員外散騎常侍高聰聘於齊。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renzi, an edict appointed Acting Staff Officer of the Scattered Cavalry Gao Cong envoy to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the ninth month Acting Staff Officer Gao Cong was sent to Qi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔車駕所經，傷人秋稼者，畝給谷五斛。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict said that wherever the imperial carriage passed and autumn crops were injured, five hu of grain per mu were to be given.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day wherever the emperor passed and autumn crops were injured, five hu of grain per mu were given.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，濟河。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the river was crossed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the river was crossed.

sentences.zh: 詔洛、懷、並、肆所過四州，賜高年爵，恤鰥寡孤獨各有差。

translations.idiomatic: In Luo, Huai, Bing, and Si through which the emperor passed, the aged received ranks and orphans, widows, and the solitary relief in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 孝悌廉義文武應求者，皆以名聞。

translations.idiomatic: Those filial, brotherly, incorrupt, righteous, civil, and martial who answered the call were reported by name.

sentences.zh: 又詔廝養戶不得與庶士婚，有文武之才積勞應進者，同庶族例，聽之。

translations.idiomatic: Another edict said stable households must not marry commoners; those with talent and merit who should advance were heard like common clans.

sentences.zh: 庚午，幸洛陽，周巡故宮基跡。

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he visited Luoyang and toured the old palace foundations.

sentences.zh: 」遂詠《黍離詩》，為之流涕。

translations.idiomatic: He recited Millet Fallen and wept.

sentences.zh: 壬申，觀河橋。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, he viewed the river bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he viewed the river bridge.

sentences.zh: 幸太學，觀石經。

translations.literal: He visited the Imperial Academy and viewed the stone classics.
translations.idiomatic: He visited the Imperial Academy and viewed the stone classics.

sentences.zh: 丙子，六軍發軫。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the six armies set out.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the six armies set out.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，帝戎服執鞭，御馬而出。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Emperor in military dress held the whip and went out mounted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the Emperor in military dress held the whip and rode out.

sentences.zh: 群臣稽顙於馬前，請停南伐，帝乃止。

translations.literal: The ministers prostrated themselves before his horse and requested that the southern campaign be halted; the Emperor then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers prostrated before his horse and begged him to halt the southern campaign; the Emperor stopped.

sentences.zh: 仍議遷都計。

translations.literal: Discussion of moving the capital was resumed.
translations.idiomatic: Discussion of moving the capital resumed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅朔，幸金墉城。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day wuyin, he visited Jinyong City.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the first of the tenth month of winter, he visited Jinyong City.

sentences.zh: 詔征司空穆亮與尚書李沖、將作大匠董爵經始洛京。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Acting Minister of Works Mu Liang, Minister of the Masters of Writing Li Chong, and Master of Works Dong Jue to plan and begin Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Minister of Works Mu Liang, Minister Li Chong, and Master of Works Dong Jue were ordered to plan and begin Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，幸河南城。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he visited Henan City.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he visited Henan City.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸豫州。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, he visited Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day he visited Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，次於石濟。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, he halted at Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day he halted at Shiji.

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the alert was lifted.

translations.literal: An altar was set up at Huatai Palace.
translations.idiomatic: An altar was set up at Huatai Palace.

translations.literal: An edict granted one rank to those of the capital and all provinces who followed the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Those of the capital and provinces who followed the campaign received one rank.

sentences.zh: 應募者，加二級。

translations.literal: Volunteers received two additional ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteers received two additional ranks.

sentences.zh: 主將加三級。

translations.literal: Commanding generals received three additional ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Commanding generals received three additional ranks.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，幸鄴城。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, he visited Ye City.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day he visited Ye City.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔安定王休率從官迎家口於代，車駕送於漳水上。

translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince of Anding Xiu was ordered to meet families at Dai; the emperor escorted them to the Zhang River.

translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor first campaigned south, palaces were raised west of Ye.

translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the eleventh month the palace was finished and the court moved there.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，巡省六軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuyin, the six armies were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the twelfth month the six armies were reviewed.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day soldiers were to be cared for in secret: the dead, diseased, and wounded generously provided for.

translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the first of the eighteenth year, the court was held at Chengluan Hall of the Ye palace.

translations.idiomatic: In Xiang, Yan, and Yu the aged received ranks and orphans, widows, and the aged and solitary relief in varying amounts.

translations.idiomatic: Those filial, brotherly, incorrupt, righteous, civil, and martial who answered the call were reported by name.

translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day he passed Bi Gan's tomb of Yin and sacrificed with the great victim.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸洛陽西宮。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, he visited the western palace of Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he visited the western palace of Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，行幸河陰，規建方澤之所。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jichou, he traveled to Heyin and planned the site for the Square Pond.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the second month he traveled to Heyin and planned the Square Pond site.

sentences.zh: 丙申，徙封河南王幹為趙郡王，潁川王雍為高陽王。

translations.idiomatic: On renyin day a northern tour began.

translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Qi envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔喻天下以遷都意。

translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict proclaimed to the realm the intent to move the capital.

translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the intercalary month he halted south of Gouzhu Pass.

sentences.zh: 皇太子朝於蒲地。

translations.literal: The crown prince attended court at Pu.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince attended court at Pu.

sentences.zh: 壬申，至平城宮。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, he reached Pingcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he reached Pingcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，臨朝堂，部分遷留。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, he attended court and assigned who should move and who remain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he attended court and assigned who should move and who remain.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，謁永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he visited Yonggu Tomb.

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengchen, sacrifice to heaven at the western suburb was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the third month western suburban sacrifice to heaven was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，帝臨太極殿，喻在代群臣遷移之略。

translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor attended Taiji Hall and explained migration to the ministers at Dai.

translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the fifth-month and seventh-month feasts were abolished.

translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the seventh month of autumn Prince of Song Liu Chang became Grand General.

translations.idiomatic: On renchen day a northern tour began.

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, he visited Jin Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day he visited Jin Tomb.

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, he visited Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day he visited Shuozhou.

translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Luan of Qi killed his ruler Zhaoye.
