translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day haihai, the crown prince attended court at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on haihai day, the crown prince attended court at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，行幸陰山，觀雲川。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, he traveled to Yinshan and viewed the Cloud River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day he traveled to Yinshan and viewed the Cloud River.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸閱武臺，臨觀講武。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, he visited the Review Troops Platform and observed military exercises.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he visited the Review Troops Platform and observed military exercises.

sentences.zh: 因幸懷朔、武川、撫冥、柔玄等四鎮。

translations.literal: He then visited the four garrisons of Huaishuo, Wuchuan, Fuming, and Rouxuan.
translations.idiomatic: He then visited the four garrisons of Huaishuo, Wuchuan, Fuming, and Rouxuan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，南還。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, he returned south.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day he returned south.

sentences.zh: 所過皆親見高年，問人疾苦，貧窘孤老者，賜以粟帛。

translations.literal: Wherever he passed he personally saw the aged, inquired into the people's hardships, and gave grain and cloth to the poor, distressed, orphaned, and aged.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he passed he saw the aged, asked after hardship, and gave grain and cloth to the poor, distressed, orphaned, and aged.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔六鎮及禦夷城人年老孤貧廢疾者，賜粟宥罪各有差。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, an edict granted grain and pardoned crimes in varying amounts to the aged, orphaned, poor, and disabled of the six garrisons and Yuyi City.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the six garrisons and Yuyi City's aged, orphaned, poor, and disabled received grain and pardons in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，車駕次旋鴻池。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the imperial carriage halted at Xuanhong Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the emperor halted at Xuanhong Pool.

sentences.zh: 庚午，謁永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he visited Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 辛未，還平城宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, he returned to Pingcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day he returned to Pingcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申朔，詔曰：「三載考績，自古通經，三考黜陟，以彰能否。

translations.literal: On the first day renshen in the ninth month, an edict said: "Three-year examination of merit is the constant canon from antiquity; three examinations determine promotion and demotion to show ability or inability."
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the first of the ninth month, an edict said: "Three-year examination of merit is the constant canon from antiquity; three examinations show ability or inability."

sentences.zh: 朕今三載一考，考即黜陟。

translations.literal: We now examine once every three years; upon examination comes promotion or demotion.
translations.idiomatic: We now examine once every three years; upon examination comes promotion or demotion.

sentences.zh: 欲令愚滯無妨於賢者，才能不擁於下位。

translations.literal: We wish the dull and obstructed not to block the worthy, and talent not to be crowded in low position.
translations.idiomatic: We wish the dull not to block the worthy and talent not to be crowded below.

sentences.zh: 各令當曹，考其優劣為三等。

translations.literal: Each office is to examine its men's excellence or inferiority as three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Each office is to grade its men excellent, middling, or inferior.

sentences.zh: 六品已下，尚書重問；

translations.literal: For the sixth rank and below, the Masters of Writing re-examine;
translations.idiomatic: For the sixth rank and below, the Masters of Writing re-examine;

sentences.zh: 五品已上，朕將親與公卿論其善惡。

translations.literal: for the fifth rank and above, we shall personally debate good and evil with the dukes and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: for the fifth rank and above, we shall personally debate merit with dukes and ministers.

sentences.zh: 上上者遷之，下下者黜之，中中者守其本任。

translations.literal: The highest of high are promoted; the lowest of low are demoted; the middle of middle keep their original posts.
translations.idiomatic: The highest are promoted; the lowest demoted; the middle keep their posts.

sentences.zh: 」壬午，帝臨朝堂，親加黜陟。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the Emperor attended court and personally promoted and demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Emperor attended court and personally promoted and demoted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，陰平王楊炅來朝。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Prince of Yinping Yang Jiong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Yinping Yang Jiong came to court.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，以太尉、東陽王丕為太傅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiachen, Grand Commandant Prince of Dongyang Pi was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the tenth month of winter Grand Commandant Prince of Dongyang Pi became Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，親告太廟，奉迎神主。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, he personally announced at the Grand Temple and welcomed the spirit tablets.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day he announced at the Grand Temple and welcomed the spirit tablets.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，車駕發平城宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the imperial carriage departed Pingcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor left Pingcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，次於中山之唐湖。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, he halted at Tang Lake in Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day he halted at Tang Lake in Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，分遣侍臣，巡問疾苦。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, attendant ministers were dispatched separately to inquire into hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day attendant ministers were sent separately to inquire into hardship.

sentences.zh: 己巳，幸信都。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he visited Xin Du.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day he visited Xin Du.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔曰：「比聞緣邊之蠻，多有竊掠，致有父子乖離，室家分絕。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, an edict said: "We have heard that frontier barbarians often raid and steal, causing fathers and sons to be torn apart and families separated."
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict said: "Frontier barbarians often raid and steal, tearing fathers from sons and families apart."

sentences.zh: 可詔荊、郢、東荊三州，勒諸蠻人，勿有侵暴。

translations.literal: The three provinces of Jing, Ying, and eastern Jing are to be ordered to restrain the barbarians from violence.
translations.idiomatic: Jing, Ying, and eastern Jing were told to restrain barbarians from violence.

sentences.zh: 」是月，齊蕭鸞殺其主昭文而自立。

translations.literal: That month, Xiao Luan of Qi killed his ruler Zhaowen and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Luan of Qi killed his ruler Zhaowen and installed himself.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未朔，詔冀、定二州，賜高年爵，恤鰥寡孤老各有差。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day xinwei, an edict ordered that in Ji and Ding provinces the aged were granted ranks and orphans, widows, and the aged and solitary were relieved in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the first of the eleventh month, Ji and Ding granted ranks to the aged and relieved orphans, widows, and the aged and solitary.

sentences.zh: 孝義廉貞文武應求者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Those filial, righteous, incorrupt, firm, civil, and martial who answered the call were all reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Those filial, righteous, incorrupt, firm, civil, and martial who answered the call were reported by name.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸鄴。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, he visited Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day he visited Ye.

sentences.zh: 甲申，經比幹墓，親為吊文，樹碑刊之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, he passed the tomb of Bi Gan and personally composed a mourning text and erected a stele to inscribe it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he passed Bi Gan's tomb, composed mourning text, and set up a stele.

sentences.zh: 己丑，車駕至洛陽。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the imperial carriage reached Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the emperor reached Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑朔，分命諸將南征。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day xinchou, various generals were ordered separately to campaign south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the first of the twelfth month, generals were ordered south separately.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，革衣服之制。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the system of clothing was reformed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the clothing system was reformed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered alert within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day alert was ordered within and without.

sentences.zh: 戊申，復代遷戶租賦三歲。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, rent and levies of relocated households from Dai were remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day rent and levies of households relocated from Dai were remitted three years.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔王、公、伯、子、男開國食邑者：王食半；

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, an edict said that kings, dukes, marquises, viscounts, and barons with enfeoffment income: princes receive half;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day enfeoffed kings, dukes, marquises, viscounts, and barons: princes receive half;

sentences.zh: 公三分食一；

translations.literal: dukes one-third;
translations.idiomatic: dukes one-third;

sentences.zh: 侯、伯四分食一；

translations.literal: marquises and earls one-fourth;
translations.idiomatic: marquises and earls one-fourth;

sentences.zh: 子、男五分食一。

translations.literal: viscounts and barons one-fifth.
translations.idiomatic: viscounts and barons one-fifth.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，車駕南伐。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the imperial carriage campaigned south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the emperor campaigned south.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔郢、豫二州賜高年爵，恤孤寡鰥老各有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict ordered that in Ying and Yu provinces the aged were granted ranks and orphans and widows were relieved in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Ying and Yu granted ranks to the aged and relieved orphans and widows.

sentences.zh: 緣路之丁，復田租一歲。

translations.literal: Corvée men along the route had field rent remitted one year.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée men along the route had field rent remitted one year.

sentences.zh: 孝悌廉貞文武應求者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Those filial, brotherly, incorrupt, firm, civil, and martial who answered the call were all reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Those filial, brotherly, incorrupt, firm, civil, and martial who answered the call were reported by name.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，車駕至懸瓠。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the imperial carriage reached Xuanhu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the emperor reached Xuanhu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔壽陽、鐘離、馬頭之師所獲男女口皆放還南。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, an edict ordered that men and women captured by the armies at Shouyang, Zhongli, and Matou were all released and returned south.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day captives from Shouyang, Zhongli, and Matou were all released south.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月辛未朔，朝饗群臣於懸瓠。

translations.literal: In the spring of the nineteenth year, on the first day xinwei, the court feasted the ministers at Xuanhu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the first of the nineteenth year, the court feasted ministers at Xuanhu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔禁淮北人不得侵掠，犯者以大辟論。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, an edict forbade people north of the Huai from raiding; offenders were judged by the great execution.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day people north of the Huai were forbidden to raid; offenders faced capital punishment.

sentences.zh: 壬午，講武於汝水西，大賫六軍。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, military exercises were held west of the Ru River and the six armies were greatly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day military exercises were held west of the Ru and the six armies were greatly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 平南將軍王肅、左將軍元麗並大破齊軍。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the South Wang Su and General of the Left Yuan Li both inflicted great defeats on the Qi army.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the South Wang Su and General of the Left Yuan Li both crushed the Qi army.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕濟淮。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the imperial carriage crossed the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the emperor crossed the Huai.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，幸八公山。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiachen, he visited Bagong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the second month he visited Bagong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 路中雨甚，詔去蓋。

translations.literal: Rain was heavy along the road; an edict ordered the canopy removed.
translations.idiomatic: Rain was heavy along the road; the canopy was ordered removed.

sentences.zh: 見軍士病者，親隱恤之。

translations.literal: Seeing sick soldiers, he personally cared for them in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing sick soldiers, he personally cared for them in secret.

sentences.zh: 戊申，車駕巡淮南，東人皆安堵，租運屬路。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the imperial carriage toured south of the Huai; easterners were all settled and rent transport lined the roads.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the emperor toured south of the Huai; easterners were settled and rent transport lined the roads.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，幸鐘離。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, he visited Zhongli.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day he visited Zhongli.

sentences.zh: 戊午，軍士禽齊人三千。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, soldiers captured three thousand Qi men.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day soldiers captured three thousand Qi men.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「在君為君，其人何罪？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "In serving a lord they were loyal; what crime have these men?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Serving their lord they were loyal; what crime have these men?"

sentences.zh: 」於是免歸。

translations.literal: Thereupon they were released and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they were released and sent home.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，發鐘離，將臨江水。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, he departed Zhongli and was about to reach the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he left Zhongli and was about to reach the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸魯城。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, he visited Lu City.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day he visited Lu City.

sentences.zh: 親祠孔子廟。

translations.literal: He personally sacrificed at the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: He personally sacrificed at the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔拜孔氏四人，顏氏二人為官。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, an edict appointed four men of the Kong clan and two of the Yan clan to office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day four men of the Kong clan and two of the Yan were appointed to office.

sentences.zh: 詔兗州刺史舉部內士人堪軍國及守宰政績者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the regional inspector of Yan Province to recommend scholars within his jurisdiction fit for military and state affairs and magistrates with political achievement, all reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's regional inspector was told to recommend scholars fit for state and military service and worthy magistrates by name.

sentences.zh: 詔賜兗州人爵及粟帛如徐州。

translations.literal: An edict granted ranks and grain and cloth to the people of Yan Province as in Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Province received ranks and grain and cloth as Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 又詔選諸孔宗子一人封崇聖侯，邑一百戶，以奉孔子祀。

translations.literal: Another edict selected one man of the Kong clan to be enfeoffed Marquis of Sacred Sagacity with one hundred households to maintain sacrifice to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: One Kong clansman was enfeoffed Marquis of Sacred Sagacity with one hundred households for Confucius's sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 命兗州為孔子起園栢，修飾墳隴，更建碑銘，褒揚聖德。

translations.literal: Yan Province was ordered to plant garden cypress for Confucius, repair the tomb mound, and rebuild the stele inscription to praise sacred virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Province was ordered to plant cypress for Confucius, repair the tomb, and rebuild the stele to praise sacred virtue.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，行幸碻磝。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, he traveled to Queao.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day he traveled to Queao.

sentences.zh: 太和廟成。

translations.literal: The Taihe Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Taihe Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，城陽王鸞赭陽失利，降為定襄縣王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jisi, Prince of Chengyang Luan lost Zheyang and was reduced to Prince of Dingxiang County.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the fifth month Prince of Chengyang Luan lost Zheyang and was reduced to Prince of Dingxiang County.

sentences.zh: 廣川王諧薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Guangchuan Xie died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guangchuan Xie died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遷文成皇后馮氏神主於太和廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the spirit tablet of Empress Wenming Feng was moved to Taihe Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Empress Wenming Feng's spirit tablet was moved to Taihe Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，行幸滑臺。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he traveled to Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he traveled to Huatai.

sentences.zh: 丙子，次於石濟。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, he halted at Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he halted at Shiji.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，皇太子朝於平桃城。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the crown prince attended court at Pingtao City.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the crown prince attended court at Pingtao City.

sentences.zh: 癸未，車駕至自南伐。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the imperial carriage returned from the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the emperor returned from the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲申，滅閑官祿以裨軍國之用。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, salaries of idle offices were abolished to supplement military and state use.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day salaries of idle offices were abolished for military and state use.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，行飲至禮，班賜各有差。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the victory feast was held and rewards distributed in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the victory feast was held and rewards distributed in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 甲午，皇太子冠於廟。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the crown prince was capped at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the crown prince was capped at the temple.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，詔不得以北俗之語，言於朝廷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jihai, an edict forbade speaking northern dialect at court.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the sixth month northern dialect at court was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 違者，免所居官。

translations.literal: Violators were removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Violators were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔復軍士從駕渡淮者租賦三年。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, an edict remitted three years' rent for soldiers who followed the emperor across the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day three years' rent was remitted for soldiers who crossed the Huai with the emperor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔皇太子赴平城宮。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered the crown prince to go to Pingcheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the crown prince was ordered to Pingcheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔濟州、東郡、滎陽及河南諸縣車駕所經者，賜高年爵，恤孤寡老疾各有差。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict ordered that in Ji, Dongjun, Xingyang, and the counties of Henan through which the emperor passed, the aged were granted ranks and orphans, widows, aged, sick, and solitary were relieved in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day counties the emperor passed in Ji, Dongjun, Xingyang, and Henan granted ranks to the aged and relieved orphans, widows, aged, sick, and solitary.

translations.literal: The edict concluded.
translations.idiomatic: The edict concluded.

sentences.zh: 孝悌廉義文武應求者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Those filial, brotherly, righteous, incorrupt, civil, and martial who answered the call were all reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Those filial, brotherly, righteous, incorrupt, civil, and martial who answered the call were reported by name.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，求天下遺書。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, lost books throughout the realm were sought.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day lost books throughout the realm were sought.

sentences.zh: 秘閣所無，有裨時用者，加以厚賞。

translations.literal: What the secret archive lacked and was useful for the time received generous reward.
translations.idiomatic: What the secret archive lacked and was useful received generous reward.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，曲赦梁州，復人田租三歲。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, a partial amnesty was granted for Liang Province and field rent was remitted three years.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Liang Province received partial amnesty and three years' rent remission.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔遷洛人，死葬河南，不得還北。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict ordered that those who moved to Luo who died were buried in Henan and not returned north.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day those who moved to Luo who died were buried in Henan and not returned north.

sentences.zh: 於是代人南遷者，悉為河南洛陽人。

translations.literal: Thereupon those of Dai stock who moved south all became people of Henan and Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon those of Dai who moved south all became people of Henan and Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔改長尺大斗，依《周禮》制度，班之天下。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, an edict reformed the long foot and great bushel according to the Rites of Zhou and distributed them throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the long foot and great bushel were reformed per the Rites of Zhou and distributed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，幸西宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, he visited the western palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn he visited the western palace.

sentences.zh: 路見壞冢露棺，駐輦埋之。

translations.literal: Along the road he saw ruined tombs with exposed coffins; he halted the carriage and buried them.
translations.idiomatic: Along the road he saw ruined tombs with exposed coffins; he halted and buried them.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔選天下勇士十五萬人為羽林、武賁，以充宿衛。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict selected one hundred fifty thousand brave men throughout the realm as Feathered Forest and Martial Guard to fill the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day one hundred fifty thousand brave men were selected as Feathered Forest and Martial Guard for the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔諸從兵從征被傷者，皆聽還本。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered that followers wounded in campaign might all return home.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day followers wounded in campaign might return home.

sentences.zh: 金墉宮成。

translations.literal: Jinyong Palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: Jinyong Palace was completed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，引群臣歷宴殿堂。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the ministers were led through successive feasts in the halls.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day ministers were led through successive feasts in the halls.

sentences.zh: 九月，六宮及文武盡遷洛陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the six palaces and civil and military officials all moved to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the six palaces and civil and military officials all moved to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，行幸鄴。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, he traveled to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day he traveled to Ye.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔諸墓舊銘記見存昭然為時人所知者，三公及位從公者，去墓三十步。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict said that for old tomb inscriptions still clearly known to contemporaries: for the three excellencies and those of noble rank from the duke, thirty paces from the tomb;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day for old tomb inscriptions still known: three excellencies and noble rank from duke, thirty paces from the tomb;

sentences.zh: 尚書令仆、九列，十五步。

translations.literal: Masters of Writing directors and the nine ministers, fifteen paces.
translations.idiomatic: Masters of Writing directors and nine ministers, fifteen paces.

sentences.zh: 黃門、五校，十步：各不聽墾殖。

translations.literal: Yellow Gate and five commandants, ten paces: cultivation was forbidden in each zone.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow Gate and five commandants, ten paces: cultivation forbidden in each zone.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣黃門郎以太牢祭比幹墓。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, a Yellow Gate gentleman was sent to sacrifice at Bi Gan's tomb with the great victim.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day a Yellow Gate gentleman sacrificed at Bi Gan's tomb with the great victim.

sentences.zh: 乙未，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，曲赦相州，賜高年爵，恤孤老痼疾各有差。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiachen, a partial amnesty was granted for Xiang Province; the aged were granted ranks and orphans, aged, and chronically ill were relieved in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the tenth month of winter Xiang received partial amnesty; the aged received ranks and orphans, aged, and chronically ill relief.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕至自鄴。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the imperial carriage returned from Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the emperor returned from Ye.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔州郡舉士。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, an edict ordered provinces and commanderies to recommend scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day provinces and commanderies were told to recommend scholars.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔諸州牧考屬官為三等之科以聞，將加親覽，以定升降。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict ordered regional inspectors to examine subordinate officials as a three-grade standard and report; the emperor would personally review to fix promotion and demotion.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day regional inspectors were to grade subordinates in three grades for the emperor's review.

sentences.zh: 詔徐、兗、光、南、青、荊、洛七州嚴纂戎備，應須赴集。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xu, Yan, Guang, southern, Qing, Jing, and Luo provinces to tighten military readiness and muster as needed.
translations.idiomatic: Xu, Yan, Guang, southern, Qing, Jing, and Luo were told to tighten readiness and muster as needed.

sentences.zh: 十一月，行幸委粟山。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, he traveled to Weisu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he traveled to Weisu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 議定圓丘。

translations.literal: The Round Mound was debated and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The Round Mound was debated and fixed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the Round Mound was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Round Mound was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未朔，引見群臣光極堂，宣下品令，為大選之始。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day yiwei, the ministers were summoned at Guangji Hall; rank regulations were proclaimed as the beginning of the great selection.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the first of the twelfth month, ministers were summoned at Guangji Hall; rank regulations began the great selection.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以咸陽王禧為長兼太尉，復前南安王楨本爵。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Prince of Xianyang Xi was made acting Grand Commandant and former Prince of Nan'an Zhen was restored to original rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Prince of Xianyang Xi became acting Grand Commandant and former Prince of Nan'an Zhen was restored.

sentences.zh: 甲子，引見群臣光極堂，班賜冠服。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the ministers were summoned at Guangji Hall and caps and robes distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day ministers were summoned at Guangji Hall and caps and robes distributed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、鄧至、吐谷渾等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year, Goguryeo, Dengzhi, Tuyuhun, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Dengzhi, Tuyuhun, and others sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月丁卯，詔改姓元氏。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twentieth year, on the day dingmao in the first month, an edict changed the surname to Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the first month of the twentieth year the surname was changed to Yuan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，封始平王勰為彭城王，復封定襄王鸞為城陽王。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Prince of Shiping Xie was enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng and Prince of Dingxiang Luan was restored as Prince of Chengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Shiping Xie became Prince of Pengcheng and Prince of Dingxiang Luan was restored Prince of Chengyang.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，幸華林，聽訟於都亭。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinchou, he visited Hualin and heard lawsuits at the capital pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the second month he visited Hualin and heard lawsuits at the capital pavilion.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔自非金革，皆聽終三年喪。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, an edict said that except for war, all might complete the three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict said except for war all might complete three-year mourning.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔畿內七十己上，暮春赴京師，將行養老禮。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, an edict ordered those aged seventy and above within the capital districts to come to the capital in late spring for the rite of caring for the aged.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day those seventy and above in the capital districts were to come in late spring for the rite of caring for the aged.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幸華林，聽訟於都亭。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, he visited Hualin and heard lawsuits at the capital pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day he visited Hualin and heard lawsuits at the capital pavilion.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，車駕閱武於小平津。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuchen, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Xiaoping Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the ninth month the emperor reviewed troops at Xiaoping Ford.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，將通洛水入谷，帝親臨觀。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Luo River was to be connected into the valley; the Emperor personally observed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Luo was to be connected into the valley; the Emperor observed in person.

sentences.zh: 庚寅晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, gengyin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the last day of the month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，以代遷之士，皆為羽林、武賁。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuxu, all soldiers relocated from Dai were made Feathered Forest and Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the tenth month of winter soldiers relocated from Dai became Feathered Forest and Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 司州之人，十二夫調一吏，為四年更卒，歲開番假，以供公私方役。

translations.literal: Among the people of Si Province, one clerk was levied per twelve men for four-year rotation; seasonal leave was opened each year for public and private corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In Si Province one clerk was levied per twelve men on four-year rotation; seasonal leave was opened yearly for corvée.

sentences.zh: 己酉，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, a partial amnesty was granted for the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the capital received a partial pardon.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，復封前汝陰王天賜孫景和為汝陰王，前京兆王太興為西河王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yiyou, the former Prince of Yiyin Tianci's grandson Jinghe was restored as Prince of Yiyin and former Prince of Jingzhao Tai Xing as Prince of Xihe.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the eleventh month former Prince of Yiyin Tianci's grandson Jinghe was restored Prince of Yiyin and former Prince of Jingzhao Tai Xing Prince of Xihe.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，以西北州郡旱儉，遣侍臣巡察，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiazi, because northwest provinces and commanderies suffered drought and scarcity, attendant ministers were sent to inspect, open granaries, and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the twelfth month northwest provinces suffered drought; ministers inspected and opened granaries.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，開鹽池禁。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the salt pond prohibition was opened.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the salt pond prohibition was opened.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，廢皇太子恂為庶人。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Crown Prince Xun was deposed as commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Crown Prince Xun was deposed as commoner.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，置常平倉。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Ever-Normal Granary was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Ever-Normal Granary was established.

sentences.zh: 樂陵王思譽知恒州刺史穆泰謀反不告，削爵為庶人。

translations.literal: Prince of Leling Si Yu knew that Hengzhou regional inspector Mu Tai plotted rebellion and did not report it; his rank was stripped and he was made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Leling Si Yu knew Mu Tai of Hengzhou plotted rebellion and did not report it; he was stripped to commoner.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月丙申，立皇子恪為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-first year, on the day bingshen in the first month, the imperial son Ke was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the first month of the twenty-first year the imperial son Ke was established crown prince.

sentences.zh: 賜天下為父後者爵一級。

translations.literal: All throughout the realm who had become heirs for their fathers were granted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the realm men who had become heirs for their fathers received one rank.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣侍臣巡方省察，問人疾苦，黜陟守宰。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, attendant ministers were sent to tour the regions, inquire into hardships, and promote or demote magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day ministers toured regions, asked after hardship, and promoted or demoted magistrates.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，北巡。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, a northern tour began.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day a northern tour began.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，次於太原。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renxu, he halted at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the second month he halted at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 親見高年，問所不便。

translations.literal: He personally saw the aged and asked what was inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: He saw the aged in person and asked what was inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔并州士人年六十以上，假以郡守。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, an edict granted acting commandery governorship to scholars of Bing Province aged sixty and above.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Bing scholars aged sixty and above received acting commandery governorship.

sentences.zh: 先是，定州人王金鉤訛言自稱應王。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wang Jingou of Ding Province spread false words and proclaimed himself the responsive king.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Jingou of Ding spread false words and called himself the responsive king.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，州郡捕斬之。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the province and commandery captured and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the province and commandery captured and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，車駕至平城。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the imperial carriage reached Pingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the emperor reached Pingcheng.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，謁永固陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he visited Yonggu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day he visited Yonggu Tomb.

sentences.zh: 乙未，南巡。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, a southern tour began.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day a southern tour began.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔汾州賜高年爵各有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, an edict granted ranks to the aged of Fen Province in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the aged of Fen Province received ranks in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，次平陽。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, he halted at Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day he halted at Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 使以太牢祭唐堯。

translations.literal: An envoy was sent to sacrifice to Tang Yao with the great victim.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy sacrificed to Tang Yao with the great victim.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，幸龍門。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengshen, he visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the fourth month of summer he visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 使以太牢祭夏禹。

translations.literal: An envoy was sent to sacrifice to Yu of Xia with the great victim.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy sacrificed to Yu of Xia with the great victim.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，幸蒲阪。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, he visited Puban.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day he visited Puban.

sentences.zh: 使以太牢祭虞舜。

translations.literal: An envoy was sent to sacrifice to Yu Shun with the great victim.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy sacrificed to Yu Shun with the great victim.

sentences.zh: 修堯、舜、夏禹廟。

translations.literal: The temples of Yao, Shun, and Yu of Xia were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The temples of Yao, Shun, and Yu of Xia were repaired.

sentences.zh: 其營船夫，賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Boatmen who built ships were granted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Boatmen who built ships received one rank.

sentences.zh: 孤寡鰥貧，各賜谷帛。

translations.literal: Orphans, widows, and the poor each received grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans, widows, and the poor each received grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 其孝友德義文武才幹，悉仰貢舉。

translations.literal: Those filial, friendly, virtuous, righteous, civil, martial, and talented were all to be recommended upward.
translations.idiomatic: Those filial, friendly, virtuous, righteous, civil, martial, and talented were all recommended upward.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，使以太牢祭周文王於酆，祭周武王於鎬。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, envoys were sent to sacrifice to King Wen of Zhou at Feng and King Wu of Zhou at Hao with the great victim.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day envoys sacrificed to King Wen at Feng and King Wu at Hao with the great victim.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣使祭華嶽。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an envoy was sent to sacrifice at Mount Hua.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day an envoy was sent to sacrifice at Mount Hua.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，車駕至自長安。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, the imperial carriage returned from Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the sixth month the emperor returned from Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔冀、定、瀛、相、濟五州，發卒士二十萬，將以南討。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict ordered the five provinces of Ji, Ding, Ying, Xiang, and Ji to levy two hundred thousand soldiers for a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Ji, Ding, Ying, Xiang, and Ji were told to levy two hundred thousand soldiers for a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，司空穆亮遜位。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Minister of Works Mu Liang yielded office.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Minister of Works Mu Liang yielded office.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，立昭儀馮氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiawu, Lady Feng of Zhaoyi was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the seventh month of autumn Lady Feng of Zhaoyi was established empress.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，帝親為群臣講《喪服》於清徽堂。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Emperor personally lectured the ministers on Mourning Garments at Qinghui Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor lectured ministers on Mourning Garments at Qinghui Hall.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，詔中外戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day bingchen, an edict ordered alert within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eighth month alert was ordered within and without.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，立皇子愉為京兆王，懌為清河王，懷為廣平王。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the imperial sons Yu, Yi, and Huai were established as Prince of Jingzhao, Prince of Qinghe, and Prince of Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the imperial sons Yu, Yi, and Huai became Prince of Jingzhao, Prince of Qinghe, and Prince of Guangping.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，講武於華林園。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, military exercises were held in Hualin Park.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day military exercises were held in Hualin Park.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，車駕南討。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the imperial carriage campaigned south.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the emperor campaigned south.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，詔司州洛陽人年七十以上無子孫，六十以上無期親，貧不自存者，給以衣食。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingshen, an edict ordered that people of Luoyang in Si Province aged seventy and above without descendants, or sixty and above without close kin, who could not support themselves, were to be given food and clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the ninth month Luoyang people seventy and above without descendants or sixty without close kin who could not support themselves received food and clothing.

sentences.zh: 及不滿六十而有廢痼之疾，無大功親，窮困無以自療者，皆於別坊，遣醫救護，給太醫師四人，豫請藥物療之。

translations.literal: And those under sixty with chronic illness, without great-affection kin, too poor to treat themselves, were all placed in separate wards; physicians were sent to care for them and four imperial physicians were provided to prepare medicines for treatment.
translations.idiomatic: Those under sixty with chronic illness and no great-affection kin, too poor to treat themselves, were placed in separate wards with four imperial physicians and medicines.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，帝留諸將攻赭陽，引師南討。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Emperor left generals to attack Zheyang and led the army south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor left generals at Zheyang and led the army south.

sentences.zh: 丁未，車駕發南陽，留太尉咸陽王禧、前將軍元英攻之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the imperial carriage departed Nanyang; Grand Commandant Prince of Xianyang Xi and General of the Front Yuan Ying were left to attack it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the emperor left Nanyang; Grand Commandant Prince of Xianyang Xi and General of the Front Yuan Ying were left to attack.

sentences.zh: 己酉，車駕至新野。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the imperial carriage reached Xinye.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the emperor reached Xinye.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，四面進攻不克，詔左右軍築長圍以守之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingsi, attack from four sides did not succeed; an edict ordered the left and right armies to build a long encirclement to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the tenth month of winter four-sided attack failed; the left and right armies were ordered to build a long encirclement.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，追廢貞皇后林氏為庶人。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Deposed Empress Lin was further deposed as commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Deposed Empress Lin was further deposed as commoner.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，大破齊軍於沔北。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dingyou, the Qi army was greatly defeated north of the Mian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the eleventh month the Qi army was crushed north of the Mian.

sentences.zh: 於是人皆復業。

translations.literal: Thereupon all men returned to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon all men returned to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 九十以上，假以郡守。

translations.literal: Those ninety and above received acting commandery governorship.
translations.idiomatic: Those ninety and above received acting commandery governorship.

sentences.zh: 六十五以上，假以縣令。

translations.literal: Those sixty-five and above received acting county magistracy.
translations.idiomatic: Those sixty-five and above received acting county magistracy.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，詔流、徙之囚，皆勿決遣，登城之際，令其先鋒自效。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingmao, an edict ordered that exiled and relocated prisoners not be decided and sent away; at the time of assaulting cities they were to serve as vanguard to prove themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the twelfth month exiled and relocated prisoners were held undecided; at assault they served as vanguard to prove themselves.

sentences.zh: 庚午，車駕臨沔，遂東還。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the imperial carriage reached the Mian and then turned east.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the emperor reached the Mian and turned east.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，還新野。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, he returned to Xinye.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day he returned to Xinye.

sentences.zh: 己卯，親行營壘，恤六軍。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he personally walked the camps and comforted the six armies.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he walked the camps and comforted the six armies.

sentences.zh: 以齊郡王子琛紹河間王若後。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi Commandery Zichen succeeded Prince of Hejian Ruo.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Commandery Zichen succeeded Prince of Hejian Ruo.

sentences.zh: 高昌國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The state of Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Gaochang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月癸未朔，饗群臣於新野行宮。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-second year, on the first day guiwei, the ministers were feasted at the Xinye traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the first of the twenty-second year, ministers were feasted at the Xinye traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，拔新野，斬其太守劉忌於宛。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Xinye was taken and its administrator Liu Ji was beheaded at Wan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Xinye was taken and administrator Liu Ji beheaded at Wan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，至自新野。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he returned from Xinye.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day he returned from Xinye.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔以穰人首歸大順始終若一者，給復三十年，標其所居曰歸義鄉。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, an edict granted thirty years' remission to Xiang men who first submitted in great obedience and remained loyal throughout, marking their dwelling as Village of Returning Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Xiang men who first submitted in great obedience received thirty years' remission; their dwelling was marked Village of Returning Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 次降者，給復十五年。

translations.literal: Those who submitted later received fifteen years' remission.
translations.idiomatic: Those who submitted later received fifteen years' remission.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午朔，大破齊將崔慧景、蕭衍軍於鄧城。

translations.literal: On the first day renwu in the third month, the armies of Qi generals Cui Huijing and Xiao Yan were greatly defeated at Deng City.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the first of the third month, Qi generals Cui Huijing and Xiao Yan were crushed at Deng City.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月戊寅朔，朝饗群臣於鄴。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-third year, on the first day wuyin, the court feasted the ministers at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the first of the twenty-third year, the court feasted ministers at Ye.

sentences.zh: 先是，帝不豫，至是有瘳。

translations.literal: Earlier the Emperor had been unwell; now he recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Emperor had been unwell; now he recovered.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，群臣上壽，大饗於澄鸞殿。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the ministers offered longevity wishes and a great feast was held at Chengluan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day ministers offered longevity wishes and a great feast was held at Chengluan Hall.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸西門豹祠，遂歷漳水而還。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, he visited the shrine of Ximen Bao and then followed the Zhang River back.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day he visited Ximen Bao's shrine and followed the Zhang River back.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，車駕至自鄴。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the imperial carriage returned from Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the emperor returned from Ye.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，車駕至馬圈。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the imperial carriage reached Maquan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the emperor reached Maquan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，頻戰破之。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, repeated battles broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day repeated battles broke the enemy.

sentences.zh: 己亥，收其戎資億計。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, military stores numbering in the hundreds of millions were seized.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day military stores numbering in the hundreds of millions were seized.

sentences.zh: 諸將追奔漢水，斬獲及赴水死者十八九。

translations.literal: The generals pursued to the Han River; those slain, captured, and drowned were eight or nine in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Generals pursued to the Han River; eight or nine in ten were slain, captured, or drowned.

sentences.zh: 庚子，帝疾甚，車駕北次谷塘原。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Emperor was gravely ill; the imperial carriage halted north at Gutang Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Emperor was gravely ill; the court halted north at Gutang Plain.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔賜皇后馮氏死。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, an edict ordered Empress Feng to die.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered Empress Feng to die.

sentences.zh: 詔司徒勰征太子於魯陽踐阼。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Minister of Works Xie to summon the crown prince at Luyang to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Xie was ordered to summon the crown prince at Luyang to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 以北海王詳為司空，王肅為尚書令，廣陽王嘉為左僕射，尚書宋弁為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Prince of Beihai Xiang was made Minister of Works, Wang Su Minister of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Guangyang Jia Left Vice Director, and Minister Song Bian Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Beihai Xiang became Minister of Works, Wang Su Minister of the Masters of Writing, Prince of Guangyang Jia Left Vice Director, and Song Bian Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 與太尉咸陽王禧、右僕射任城王澄等六人輔政。

translations.literal: With Grand Commandant Prince of Xianyang Xi, Right Vice Director Prince of Rencheng Cheng, and six others they assisted government.
translations.idiomatic: With Grand Commandant Prince of Xianyang Xi, Right Vice Director Prince of Rencheng Cheng, and six others they assisted government.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午朔，帝崩於谷塘原之行宮，時年三十三。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day bingwu, the Emperor died at the traveling palace on Gutang Plain, aged thirty-three.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the first of the fourth month of summer, the Emperor died at the traveling palace on Gutang Plain, aged thirty-three.

sentences.zh: 秘諱至魯陽發喪，還京師。

translations.literal: The death was kept secret until Luyang, when mourning was proclaimed; the coffin returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The death was kept secret until Luyang, when mourning was proclaimed; the coffin returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 上謚曰孝文皇帝，廟曰高祖。

translations.literal: The posthumous title was Emperor Xiaowen; the temple name was Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: The posthumous title was Emperor Xiaowen; the temple name Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，葬長陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingshen, he was buried at Chang Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fifth month he was buried at Chang Tomb.

sentences.zh: 帝幼有至性。

translations.literal: From childhood the Emperor had utmost nature.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood the Emperor had utmost nature.

sentences.zh: 年四歲時，獻文患癰，帝親自吮膿。

translations.literal: At age four, when Emperor Xianwen suffered an abscess, the Emperor personally sucked the pus.
translations.idiomatic: At age four, when Emperor Xianwen suffered an abscess, the Emperor sucked the pus himself.

sentences.zh: 五歲受禪，悲泣不自勝。

translations.literal: At five he received the abdication and wept beyond control.
translations.idiomatic: At five he received the abdication and wept beyond control.

sentences.zh: 獻文問其故，對曰：「代親之感，內切於心。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianwen asked the reason; he answered: "The feeling for kin of Dai cuts inward to the heart."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianwen asked why; he answered: "The feeling for kin of Dai cuts inward to the heart."

sentences.zh: 」獻文甚嘆異之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianwen greatly marveled at this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianwen greatly marveled at this.

sentences.zh: 文明太后以帝聰聖，後或不利馮氏，將謀廢帝。

translations.literal: Because the Emperor was intelligent and sage-like, the Empress Dowager Wenming feared that later the Feng clan might be harmed and plotted to depose the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Emperor was intelligent and sage-like, Empress Dowager Wenming feared the Feng clan might later be harmed and plotted to depose him.

sentences.zh: 乃於寒月，單衣閉室，絕食三朝，召咸陽王禧將立之。

translations.literal: Then in a cold month, in single garment she closed her chamber and fasted three mornings, summoning Prince of Xianyang Xi to install him.
translations.idiomatic: In a cold month, in a single garment she closed her chamber, fasted three mornings, and summoned Prince of Xianyang Xi to install him.

sentences.zh: 元丕、穆泰、李沖固諫乃止。

translations.literal: Yuan Pi, Mu Tai, and Li Chong firmly remonstrated and she stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Pi, Mu Tai, and Li Chong firmly remonstrated and she stopped.

sentences.zh: 帝初不有憾，唯深德丕等。

translations.literal: At first the Emperor bore no resentment and only deeply thanked Pi and the others.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Emperor bore no resentment and deeply thanked Pi and the others.

sentences.zh: 撫念諸弟，始終曾無纖介。

translations.literal: He cared for his younger brothers from first to last without the slightest rift.
translations.idiomatic: He cared for his younger brothers from first to last without the slightest rift.

sentences.zh: 敦睦九族，禮敬俱深。

translations.literal: He was affectionate to the nine clans and courteous in ritual to all.
translations.idiomatic: He was affectionate to the nine clans and deep in ritual courtesy to all.

sentences.zh: 雖於大臣，持法不縱。

translations.literal: Even toward great ministers he held the law and did not indulge.
translations.idiomatic: Even toward great ministers he held the law and did not indulge.

sentences.zh: 然性寬慈，進食者曾以熱羹覆帝手，又曾於食中得蟲穢物，並笑而恕之。

translations.literal: Yet by nature he was generous and kind; one who served food once spilled hot broth on the Emperor's hand, and once unclean things were found in the food, and he laughed and forgave both.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was generous and kind; one who served food spilled hot broth on his hand, and once unclean things were found in the food, and he laughed and forgave both.

sentences.zh: 宦者先有譖帝於太后，太后杖帝數十，帝默受，不自申明。

translations.literal: A eunuch had earlier slandered the Emperor to the Empress Dowager; the Empress Dowager beat the Emperor dozens of times and he silently bore it without explaining himself.
translations.idiomatic: A eunuch had slandered him to the Empress Dowager; she beat him dozens of times and he silently bore it without explaining.

sentences.zh: 太后崩後，亦不以介意。

translations.literal: After the Empress Dowager died he did not mind it.
translations.idiomatic: After the Empress Dowager died he did not mind it.

sentences.zh: 聽覽政事，從善如流。

translations.literal: In hearing government he followed good counsel like flowing water.
translations.idiomatic: In hearing government he followed good counsel like flowing water.

sentences.zh: 哀矜百姓，恒思所以濟益。

translations.literal: He pitied the common people and constantly thought how to benefit them.
translations.idiomatic: He pitied the common people and constantly thought how to benefit them.

sentences.zh: 天地、五郊、宗廟、二分之禮，帝必躬親，不以寒暑為倦。

translations.literal: Rites of Heaven and Earth, the five suburbs, the ancestral temple, and the two equinoxes: the Emperor always attended in person and was not weary of heat or cold.
translations.idiomatic: Rites of Heaven and Earth, the five suburbs, the ancestral temple, and the two equinoxes: he always attended in person and was not weary of heat or cold.

sentences.zh: 尚書奏案，多自尋省；

translations.literal: When the Masters of Writing memorialized cases, he often reviewed them himself;
translations.idiomatic: When the Masters of Writing memorialized cases, he often reviewed them himself;

sentences.zh: 百官大小，無不留心。

translations.literal: officials great and small, none escaped his attention.
translations.idiomatic: officials great and small, none escaped his attention.

sentences.zh: 務於周洽，每言：凡為人君，患於不均，不能推誠遇物；

translations.literal: He strove for thoroughness and often said: For any ruler the trouble is unevenness, not treating things with sincere openness;
translations.idiomatic: He strove for thoroughness and often said: For any ruler the trouble is unevenness, not treating things with sincere openness;

sentences.zh: 茍能均誠，胡越之人，亦可親如兄弟。

translations.literal: if one can be evenly sincere, even men of Hu and Yue can be as close as brothers.
translations.idiomatic: if one can be evenly sincere, even men of Hu and Yue can be as close as brothers.

sentences.zh: 常從容謂史官曰：「直書時事，無諱國惡。

translations.literal: He often said calmly to the historiographers: "Write the times straight and do not conceal the state's shame."
translations.idiomatic: He often told the historiographers: "Write the times straight and do not conceal the state's shame."

sentences.zh: 人君威福自己，史復不書，將何所懼！

translations.literal: When a ruler's authority and favor are his own and the historians do not write, what is there to fear!
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler's authority and favor are his own and historians do not write, what is there to fear!

sentences.zh: 」南北征巡，有司奏請修道，帝曰：「粗修橋梁，通輿馬便止，不須去草鏟令平也。

translations.literal: On southern and northern campaigns and tours, when offices memorialized to repair roads, the Emperor said: "Roughly repair bridges so carts and horses may pass; there is no need to clear grass and level the ground."
translations.idiomatic: On campaign and tour, when offices asked to repair roads, he said: "Roughly repair bridges for carts and horses; no need to clear grass and level ground."

sentences.zh: 」凡所修造，不得已而為之，不為不急之事，重損人力。

translations.literal: All construction was done only when unavoidable; he did not undertake unurgent matters and heavily burden human labor.
translations.idiomatic: All construction was only when unavoidable; he did not undertake unurgent matters and heavily burden labor.

sentences.zh: 巡幸淮南，如在內地。

translations.literal: Touring south of the Huai was like being in the inner lands.
translations.idiomatic: Touring south of the Huai was like being in the inner lands.

sentences.zh: 軍事須伐人樹者，必留絹以酬其直。

translations.literal: When the military had to cut trees, silk was left to pay the price.
translations.idiomatic: When the military cut trees, silk was left to pay the price.

sentences.zh: 人苗稼無所傷踐。

translations.literal: People's standing grain was not trampled or injured.
translations.idiomatic: People's standing grain was not trampled or injured.

sentences.zh: 諸有禁忌禳厭之方非典籍所載者，一皆除罷。

translations.literal: All taboo and exorcism formulas not recorded in the canonical tomes were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: All taboo and exorcism formulas not in the canonical tomes were abolished.

sentences.zh: 雅好讀書，手不釋卷。

translations.literal: He elegantly loved reading and never released the scroll from his hand.
translations.idiomatic: He loved reading and never released the scroll from his hand.

sentences.zh: 《五經》之義，覽之便講。

translations.literal: The meaning of the Five Classics he could expound on reading.
translations.idiomatic: The meaning of the Five Classics he could expound on reading.

sentences.zh: 學不師受，探其精奧；

translations.literal: He studied without teachers, probing their subtle depths;
translations.idiomatic: He studied without teachers, probing subtle depths;

sentences.zh: 史傳百家，無不該涉。

translations.literal: histories, transmissions, and the hundred schools, none he did not encompass.
translations.idiomatic: histories, transmissions, and the hundred schools, none he did not encompass.

sentences.zh: 善談莊、老，尤精釋義。

translations.literal: He was skilled in discussing Zhuangzi and Laozi and especially refined in Buddhist meaning.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled in Zhuangzi and Laozi and especially refined in Buddhist meaning.

sentences.zh: 才藻富贍，好為文章；

translations.literal: His literary talent was rich; he loved to write essays;
translations.idiomatic: His literary talent was rich; he loved to write essays;

sentences.zh: 詩賦銘頌，在興而作。

translations.literal: poems, rhapsodies, inscriptions, and eulogies he composed as inspiration moved him.
translations.idiomatic: poems, rhapsodies, inscriptions, and eulogies he composed as inspiration moved him.

sentences.zh: 有大文筆，馬上口授；

translations.literal: For great compositions he dictated from horseback;
translations.idiomatic: For great compositions he dictated from horseback;

sentences.zh: 及其成也，不改一字。

translations.literal: when finished he altered not a single character.
translations.idiomatic: when finished he altered not a single character.

sentences.zh: 自太和十年已後，詔冊皆帝文也。

translations.literal: From the tenth year of Taihe onward, edicts and patents were all the Emperor's writing.
translations.idiomatic: From Taihe year ten onward, edicts and patents were all the Emperor's writing.

sentences.zh: 自余文章，百有餘篇。

translations.literal: Besides these there were more than a hundred other compositions.
translations.idiomatic: Besides these there were more than a hundred other compositions.

sentences.zh: 愛奇好士，情如饑渴。

translations.literal: He loved the strange and honored scholars with hunger and thirst.
translations.idiomatic: He loved the strange and honored scholars with hunger and thirst.

sentences.zh: 待納朝賢，隨才輕重。

translations.literal: He received and employed court worthies according to talent, heavy or light.
translations.idiomatic: He received court worthies according to talent, heavy or light.

sentences.zh: 常寄以布素之意。

translations.literal: He often entrusted them with plain-cloth intentions, distant and transcendent, not binding his heart with worldly affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He often entrusted them with plain intentions, distant and transcendent, not binding his heart with worldly affairs.

sentences.zh: ，悠然玄邁，不以世務嬰心。

translations.literal: At ease and far-reaching, he did not let worldly affairs bind his heart.
translations.idiomatic: At ease and far-reaching, he did not let worldly affairs bind his heart.

sentences.zh: 又少善射，有膂力：年十餘，能以指彈碎羊膊骨；

translations.literal: He was also skilled in archery and had physical strength: in his teens he could snap sheep shoulder bones with a finger;
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled in archery and strong: in his teens he could snap sheep shoulder bones with a finger;

sentences.zh: 射禽獸，莫不隨行所至而斃之。

translations.literal: shooting birds and beasts, none failed to fall wherever he went.
translations.idiomatic: shooting birds and beasts, none failed to fall wherever he went.

sentences.zh: 至十五，便不復殺生，射獵之事悉止。

translations.literal: By fifteen he no longer killed living things and ceased all hunting.
translations.idiomatic: By fifteen he no longer killed living things and ceased all hunting.

sentences.zh: 性儉素，常服浣濯之衣，鞍勒鐵木而已。

translations.literal: By nature he was frugal and plain, often wearing washed clothes; saddle and bridle were iron and wood only.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was frugal, often wearing washed clothes; saddle and bridle were iron and wood only.

sentences.zh: 帝之雅誌，皆此類也。

translations.literal: The Emperor's refined aims were all of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's refined aims were all of this kind.

sentences.zh: 論曰：有魏始基代朔，廓平南夏；

translations.literal: The judgment says: When Wei first founded its base in the northern frontier and broadened peace in southern Xia,
translations.idiomatic: The judgment says: When Wei first founded its base in the northern frontier and broadened peace in southern Xia,

sentences.zh: 辟土經世，咸以威武為業。

translations.literal: opening territory and ordering the age, all took martial awesomeness as their enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: opening territory and ordering the age, all took martial awesomeness as enterprise.

sentences.zh: 文教之事，所未遑也。

translations.literal: Civil and cultural affairs they had no leisure to pursue.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and cultural affairs they had no leisure to pursue.

sentences.zh: 孝文纂承洪緒，早著睿聖之風。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowen succeeded the great enterprise and early showed sage-like wind.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowen succeeded the great enterprise and early showed sage-like wind.

sentences.zh: 時以文明攝事，優遊恭己；

translations.literal: At the time Empress Dowager Wenming held affairs; he rested in reverent ease;
translations.idiomatic: At the time Empress Dowager Wenming held affairs; he rested in reverent ease;

sentences.zh: 玄覽獨得，著自不言；

translations.literal: mysteriously viewing alone he attained understanding, manifest in silence;
translations.idiomatic: mysteriously viewing alone he attained understanding, manifest in silence;

sentences.zh: 神契所標，固以符於冥化。

translations.literal: what the divine covenant marked already accorded with hidden transformation.
translations.idiomatic: what the divine covenant marked already accorded with hidden transformation.

sentences.zh: 及躬總大政，一日萬機，十許年間，曾不暇給；

translations.literal: When he personally held great government, ten thousand affairs a day, for more than ten years he scarcely had leisure;
translations.idiomatic: When he personally held government, ten thousand affairs a day, for more than ten years he scarcely had leisure;

sentences.zh: 殊塗同歸，百慮一致。

translations.literal: different paths, same end; a hundred concerns, one accord.
translations.idiomatic: different paths, same end; a hundred concerns, one accord.

sentences.zh: 夫生靈所難行，人倫之高跡，雖尊居黃屋，盡蹈之矣。

translations.literal: What living beings find hard to practice and the highest trace of human relations, though he honored the yellow house, he fully trod them.
translations.idiomatic: What living beings find hard and the highest trace of human relations, though he honored the yellow house, he fully trod them.

sentences.zh: 若乃欽明稽古，協禦天人，帝王制作，朝野軌度。

translations.literal: As for reverent clarity and examining antiquity, harmonizing heaven and man, imperial regulation and court and realm standards,
translations.idiomatic: As for reverent clarity and examining antiquity, harmonizing heaven and man, imperial regulation and court standards,

sentences.zh: 斟酌用舍，煥乎其有文章。

translations.literal: weighing use and rejection, he brilliantly had culture.
translations.idiomatic: weighing use and rejection, he brilliantly had culture.

sentences.zh: 海內黔黎，咸受耳目之賜。

translations.literal: The black-haired common people within the seas all received the gift of ear and eye.
translations.idiomatic: The black-haired commoners within the seas all received the gift of ear and eye.

sentences.zh: 加以雄才大略，愛奇好士，視下如傷，役己利物，亦無得而稱之。

translations.literal: Added to heroic talent and great strategy, love of the strange and honoring scholars, treating subordinates as if wounded, taxing himself to benefit things, none could fully name it.
translations.idiomatic: Added to heroic talent and great strategy, love of the strange and honoring scholars, treating subordinates as if wounded, taxing himself to benefit things, none could fully name it.
